title: Research Engineer Privacy and Anonymization
description:
Location: San Francisco or Singapore (on-site), or remote (Singapore or US Pacific time zones)
Start Date: ASAP
Languages: English
Team: Engineering

About the Role

Our client is a fast-growing AI company building reliable, fair and open infrastructure for AI training data. Their marketplace helps the people who create data get value for it, and gives AI labs trustworthy data to train on. It is already used by startups, Fortune 500 companies and frontier labs, and the company is backed by leading venture investors, including Y Combinator. They are scaling quickly to meet strong demand.

We are looking for a Research Engineer, Privacy and Anonymization to build the systems that make sensitive, real-world data safe and still useful for AI training. You will develop methods to detect and remove personally identifiable information, secrets and other sensitive content from raw data before it enters processing and synthetic data pipelines â protecting privacy without destroying the structure and signal that make the data valuable for training agents.

This is a privacy and data-protection engineering seat, not a synthetic-task design role. You will own the pipeline that stands in front of downstream processing, training, evaluation and synthetic generation.

This is a full-time role, starting ASAP. Offices are in San Francisco and Singapore; remote candidates are welcome if their working hours can overlap about 70â80% with either San Francisco (US Pacific) or Singapore business hours. The exact daily schedule will be agreed during hiring.

What You'll Do

  • Build systems to detect PII, quasi-identifiers, credentials and other sensitive information, and design transformations based on the data type and the downstream use case.

  • Develop and benchmark detection approaches that combine rules, statistical models, classifiers and LLM-based methods.

  • Build production pipelines that anonymize raw data before it enters downstream processing, training, evaluation or synthetic data generation.

  • Create evaluation frameworks that measure privacy risk and retained data utility, including recall-weighted metrics, leakage tests and adversarial re-identification attempts.

  • Design systems that stay robust to new data sources, schema drift, unusual formats and sensitive information embedded in unexpected fields.

  • Work with engineering, research, operations and customers to translate privacy requirements into practical technical policies and safeguards.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong proficiency in Python, and experience building reliable production data or machine-learning systems.

  • Experience with information extraction, named-entity recognition, classification, or related methods for detecting rare or sensitive content.

  • Strong experimental instincts, and the ability to compare approaches across recall, precision, latency, cost and downstream data utility.

  • An understanding of the difference between redaction, masking, pseudonymization, anonymization and synthetic data â and when each is appropriate.

  • High attention to detail, and the ability to reason about subtle leakage paths, edge cases and adversarial failure modes.

  • Experience building data-processing pipelines end to end, including where there was no fully prescribed roadmap.

  • Clear written and spoken English, and comfort collaborating across teams and time zones.

  • Strong candidates may also have hands-on experience with privacy-enhancing technologies (such as differential privacy, k-anonymity, secure aggregation or format-preserving encryption); have worked with sensitive data in healthcare, finance or security; have built low-latency or high-throughput ML inference or data-processing systems; or have taken work from early research through to production.

  • Technical aptitude and learning potential matter more than years of experience. Motivated candidates are encouraged to apply even if they don't meet every point above.

Why This Role Matters for You

  • Make real-world data safe to train on: You will build the systems that let sensitive data be used for AI training without exposing people or secrets.

  • Privacy without wrecking utility: The job is not only to redact, but to keep the structure and signal that downstream training and synthetic pipelines need.

  • From detection to production: You will own the full path: detection methods, transformations, evaluation, and the pipeline that sits in front of training and generation.

  • Hard, high-stakes edge cases: Work on leakage paths, schema drift and adversarial failure modes, not only clean benchmark datasets.

  • San Francisco, Singapore, or remote: Work on-site in San Francisco or Singapore, or remotely, with hours that overlap about 70â80% with either US Pacific or Singapore business hours. The exact daily schedule will be agreed during hiring.

  • Strong test design and security fundamentals.

  • Care and attention to detail when changing live systems that handle money.

  • Experience with stream processing or high-throughput event pipelines.

  • Experience with Kubernetes.

title: hbo-stage Analyseren kwaliteit bouwvergunningen BAG
description:
hbo-afstudeerstage, vanaf februari 2027

Ben jij die nieuwsgierige en enthousiaste student die graag in data duikt en op zoek gaat naar opvallende patronen en verbanden?
Krijg jij energie van het ontrafelen van complexe vraagstukken, het ontdekken van inzichten en het vertalen van data naar betekenisvolle resultaten?

Dit is jouw uitdaging

Het CBS ontvangt maandelijks van de 342 gemeenten in Nederland informatie over verleende bouwvergunningen. Gemeenten leveren deze gegevens aan via enquêtes en registreren de bouwvergunningen daarnaast in de Basisregistratie Adressen en Gebouwen (BAG).

Sinds 2025 publiceert het CBS de cijfers over bouwvergunningen op basis van de BAG. Er is echter een groot en toenemend verschil tussen de cijfers uit de BAG en de tellingen uit de enquêtes. Er is reeds onderzoek gedaan naar deze toenemende verschillen.

Als stagiair ga je dit verder onderzoeken, door middel van een diepgaande analyse van de tijdigheid en kwaliteit van de registratie van gegevens in de BAG. Daarnaast verzamel je informatie over het registratieproces om beter inzicht te krijgen in hoe de BAG zich verhoudt tot de werkelijkheid.

Je onderzoekt onder andere:

  • Hoe lang wachten gemeenten met registraties?

  • Worden registraties doorlopend geregistreerd, of opgespaard en in korte tijd geregistreerd in de BAG?

  • Verandert de kwaliteit en tijdigheid door de tijd heen?

Om deze vragen te beantwoorden duik je in een grote database, waar je met behulp van SQL en R of Python trends gaat waarnemen, data visualiseert, en samenvattingen maakt.

Daarnaast verzamel je informatie over het registratieproces, en hoe dit is geïmplementeerd bij gemeenten. Voor deze taak is al eerder onderzoek gedaan, en is er ook al meer informatie beschikbaar. Je verzamelt deze resultaten in een rapport met een overzicht van de huidige stand van zaken.

Dit is jouw stageplek bij CBS Den Haag

Ons team bestaat uit 24 enthousiaste collega’s, die met veel passie en plezier werken aan statistische informatie over vastgoed en de woningmarkt.

We maken statistieken over (bouw)vergunningen, ontwikkeling van de woningvoorraad, (gemiddelde) WOZ-waardes, eigendomsverhoudingen, tijdelijke woningen, woningtransformaties en nog heel veel meer. We doen statistisch onderzoek op verzoek van organisaties in de publieke sector. En we beheren en verwerken data voor CBS-collega’s en werken samen met diverse organisaties, waaronder het Kadaster, de ministeries van BZK, VRO en EZK en Eurostat.

We publiceren regelmatig over de dynamiek van de Nederlandse vastgoed- en woningmarkt. Onze nieuwsberichten halen regelmatig journaals, nieuwssites en voorpagina’s van landelijke dagbladen. En daar zijn we trots op!

Dit breng jij mee

Je volgt een hbo opleiding in de studierichting toegepaste wiskunde, data science of sociale wetenschappen.

  • Je hebt affiniteit met de woningmarkt.

  • Je hebt kennis en wellicht ervaring met R/rmarkdown en/of Python en SQL databases. 

  • Je bent nieuwsgierig, leergierig en enthousiast om met data aan de slag te gaan.

  • Je vindt het leuk om nieuwe dingen te ontdekken, neemt graag initiatief en denkt actief mee.

  • Je kunt zelfstandig werken, maar zoekt ook graag de samenwerking op.

  • Je deelt gemakkelijk je ideeën en bevindingen en staat open voor nieuwe inzichten en feedback.

Omdat tijdens de stage alle communicatie – zowel mondeling als schriftelijk – in het Nederlands plaatsvindt, is een goede beheersing van de Nederlandse taal noodzakelijk.

Dit kun je van ons verwachten

Een fijne leeromgeving waarin je:

  • samenwerkt met ervaren experts binnen hun vakgebied;

  • gaat werken met grote databases (SQL);

  • kennis opbouwt van de BAG en het registratieproces bij bronhouders;

  • analyses samenvat in data visualisaties en overzichtelijke tabellen.

Voor jouw inzet ontvang je een stagevergoeding van € 800,- bruto per maand (op basis van 40 uur per week).

Samen met je stagebegeleider stem je af hoe je hybride kunt werken, met flexibele werktijden en de optie om deels vanuit huis aan jouw stageopdracht te werken.

Dit zijn onze voorwaarden

Het betreft een stageopdracht en geen werkervaringsplek. Voordat je aan de stage begint verwachten we dat je vanuit de onderwijsinstelling een stagebegeleider hebt, waarmee de stage is afgestemd en concrete leerdoelen zijn afgesproken.
Deze stageopdracht is bedoeld voor studenten die momenteel staan ingeschreven bij een onderwijsinstelling; afgestudeerden komen niet in aanmerking.

title: AI Support Engineer - Toronto
description:
About the Team

OpenAI’s User Operations team shepherds our customers’ adoption of AI and ensures that our customers' product experience is nothing short of exceptional. We are building the very first post-AGI support team. We resolve complex issues, provide technical guidance, and support customers in maximizing value and adoption from deploying our products. We work closely with Sales, Technical Success, Product, Engineering and others, to deliver the best possible experience to our customers at scale. OpenAI's customers represent a range of diverse backgrounds and maturity, from early-stage startups to established global enterprises.

About the Role

We’re looking for dedicated, experienced, and deeply curious individuals to help solve some of the most complex challenges faced by our customers while building the future of post-AGI support alongside us. In this role, you’ll work directly with customers through support tickets and live calls, troubleshooting high-impact issues and resolving novel, often ambiguous technical problems in one of the fastest-moving environments in technology. As AI adoption rapidly accelerates, the work you do will directly support mission-critical systems being built on OpenAI’s platform, serving as a critical line of defense for customers operating at massive scale.

Beyond resolving technical issues, you’ll help define what world-class support looks like in an AGI-driven future. You’ll partner closely with Engineering, Product, and Operations to improve systems, reduce bugs, and elevate the customer experience, while leveraging automation, agents, and our own AI technology to transform how support operates at scale.

This Toronto-based role is currently remote and is expected to transition to an in-office arrangement.

In this role, you will:

  • Work directly with customers to troubleshoot and resolve their most complex technical issues, including API failures, integration challenges, authentication errors, and production incidents. Providing end-to-end ownership through debugging logs, analyzing system behavior, reproducing issues, and delivering expert guidance.

  • Become a trusted expert on OpenAI’s products and platform, serving as a go-to resource for complex technical issues.

  • Serve as a critical escalation point and line of defense for complex technical issues, partnering closely with customers and Engineering teams to troubleshoot, resolve, and proactively prevent recurring problems while leveraging scripting and emerging AI capabilities to improve internal tooling and automate operational workflows.

  • Take learnings from resolving customer issues and creating our approach to scaling these solutions, partnering with Product and Go-To-Market teams.

  • Drive operational excellence by identifying opportunities for automation and AI-powered workflows, implementing scalable improvements that increase team efficiency, reducing manual effort, and elevating the overall support experience.

  • Provide occasional holiday and weekend support on call coverage, as needed, to support business and customer needs.

You might thrive in this role if you:

  • Have 5+ years of experience in User Operations, Engineering, Support Engineering or similar technical roles, ideally within high-growth tech startups or other fast-paced environments.

  • Are comfortable using emerging technologies (ie. Codex, ChatGPT, OpenAI API, etc.) to script or engineer code (e.g., Python) for automating repetitive tasks and integrating tools.

  • Have expert-level SaaS troubleshooting skills with the ability to rapidly understand new technologies and complex concepts.

  • Polished enterprise communication and are calm with high-stakes customers during live incident calls.

  • Proven experience building strong relationships with customers and cross-functional partners to drive resolution to complex issues.

  • Exceptional critical thinker and problem solver with the ability to clearly communicate complex technical issues to both customers and internal teams.

  • Thrive in ambiguity, adapt rapidly to change, continuously learn, and proactively seek opportunities for growth.

  • Bring a humble, team first mindset, a genuine eagerness to help others, and the curiosity to quickly learn whatever knowledge is needed to help both your teammates and our customers succeed.

  • Have a bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, another relevant technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity.

title: Cloud Engineer Automation
description:
Working for a company like Smile Digital Health means supporting our mandate for #BetterGlobalHealth. We strive towards this goal every day, and the results can be seen in the impact of our innovative health data platform and data management solutions, which are used in over 20 countries. We were #19 on Deloitte's Technology Fast 50 Ranking for 2024! 

 

Smile Digital Health makes it easy for healthcare stakeholders to collect and exchange data with our leading FHIR-based data liberation platform.

 

At its heart, the Smile platform enables people and organizations to better manage healthcare data. We help generate and liberate structured healthcare data to ensure effective delivery across care teams and health systems bringing  #BetterGlobalHealth to patients everyday!


Apply today and find plenty of reasons to SMILE!


The Cloud Engineer (Automation) is responsible for designing, building, operating and improving production-grade automation for Smile Digital Health, its clients and partners. This role will be responsible for the pipelines, infrastructure as code, environments and recovery procedures, that the platform runs on. 

This Engineer will merge direct platform engineering expertise with driving strategic changes in how the department designs, deploys, and maintains its infrastructure. Key responsibilities include managing build and release engineering, orchestrating the Terraform and Helm infrastructure, provisioning on-demand environments, and implementing automated recovery. This role works closely with Platform Engineering, Solution Engineering, Service Operations and Engineering Practice & QA to remove unnecessary repetitive, manual work and effectively optimize a build from the time the client commits to a running environment faster, decrease platform costs, and utilize AI to enhance the platformâs engineering and operations.

\n


Responsibilities:
  • Own build and release engineering by reviewing the current repositories and CI setup, then consolidate duplicated Azure DevOps pipeline YAML onto shared reusable templates with change detection and automated quality gates.
  • Identify and eliminate manual efforts for cross-functional teams and replace them with scheduled, auditable automation. For example, automating patching, certificate and secret rotation, environment scaling, and recurring reports
  • Implement GitOps-based continuous delivery - declarative, Git-driven deployments with automated reconciliation, drift detection and rollback.
  • Automate line-of-business environments end to end, provisioned and torn down on demand across every Azure service and application involved.
  • Automate business continuity and disaster recovery through backup validation, restore and failover, recurring DR drills, and measured RTO and RPO.
  • Ensure Helm and Terraform are easy to upgrade by charting reuse and configuration validation, versioned modules, and state boundaries that limit how far an upgrade reaches.
  • Run in-cluster platform services deployed through Helm, harden workloads for availability and capacity: health probes, replica counts, and right-sized requests, limits and autoscaling.
  • Ensure that the Terraform configuration is regularly maintained.
  • Build and maintain Build Agent images for streamlining tooling available for the builds. 
  • Automate the guardrails such as policy-as-code, security and IaC scanning in the pipeline, and alerts and dashboards defined as code.
  • Implement AI-assisted engineering in the platform teamâs day-to-day work
  • Contribute to the departmentâs AI enablement, package knowledge into reusable skills and runbooks in the shared skill library.
  • Work with the development and operations teams to find automation gaps, prioritize them, and close them.
  • Troubleshoot production and staging issues and document what you automate so others can operate it.


Requirements:
  • 6+ years of hands-on cloud engineering, DevOps and/or platform engineering experience, including at least 1-2+ years with infrastructure as code and CI/CD automation on Microsoft Azure in production.
  • Post-secondary education in Computer Science, Engineering, or similar and/or equivalent work experience. 
  • Practical in-depth knowledge and expertise in Terraform, Helm and Azure DevOps pipelines, and GitOps delivery (Argo CD or Flux). 
  • Strong Terraform skills including, but not limited to, experience with module design, provider version management, state management and refactoring.
  • Expertise in Helm chart authoring and refactoring, including recent experience with Kubernetes and AKS.
  • Demonstrated knowledge across Azure (AKS, Key Vault, Storage, Azure SQL, PostgreSQL, networking, identity) and observability as code (Azure Monitor and/or Grafana, Prometheus, OpenTelemetry).
  • Hands-on experience automating backup, restore and failover with measured RTO and RPO.
  • Hands-on experience with agentic coding tools (Claude Code or equivalent), keeping confidential data out of them and reviewing what they produce.
  • Hands-on experience running, hardening and right-sizing production workloads on Kubernetes
  • Hands-on Kafka operations: topic and partition design, consumer group sizing, and throughput and latency trade-offs. Experience migrating between Kafka platforms (HDInsight, Confluent, MSK or self-managed) is a strong asset.
  • Strong Python and Bash skills, able to build maintainable tooling, not glue scripts.
  • A demonstrable record of replacing manual processes with automation.

title: System Performance Engineer
description:
Location: Eindhoven, the Netherlands (on-site, High Tech Campus) | Type: Full-time | Level: Medior, about 3 years of relevant experience

About us

AIM Solutions is an early-stage deep-tech startup in Eindhoven building inspection and metrology equipment for the semiconductor industry. We are in active build phase, small, and growing.

The role

You measure, reconstruct and analyze real samples to find out how well our tool performs, and what holds it back. You work between the optics lab, the algorithm team, and our customers' samples, and you become our in-house expert on system performance.

You will:

  • Develop full recipes for new samples: decide what and how to measure, run scans on the lab tools, configure and run reconstructions in our Python/JAX pipeline, and judge the quality of the output

  • Run measurement campaigns on customer samples and report results on repeatability, accuracy against reference data, and throughput

  • Qualify the tool on reference samples, track image-quality KPIs against a baseline, and spot drift before it affects results

  • Investigate when a result does not look right: artifacts, convergence, noise, alignment, or calibration, and trace the cause to the module that owns it

  • Design experiments with the optics and hardware engineers, and feed findings back into the algorithms and the tool design

  • Automate recipes and checks into a single-button-press workflow

Your profile

  • About 3 years of hands-on experience in a technical role (industry, PhD, or equivalent) with imaging, optics, or scientific data analysis

  • Practical experience with computational imaging, for example phase retrieval, coherent diffractive imaging, holography, ptychography, or tomography. You have run reconstructions on real data and interpreted the results

  • You are at home in the lab: you plan measurements, run them, and know what to change to get a better result

  • Strong Python with NumPy. You write reproducible analysis code and maintain a pipeline from data ingest to results

  • A rigorous approach to measurement quality: repeatability, uncertainty, and comparison against a reference

  • You work well with optics, hardware, and software engineers and turn vague questions into repeatable tests

  • Full professional proficiency in English

Bonus:

  • Experience with metrology or inspection, ideally in the semiconductor industry

  • PyTorch or JAX, GPU computing

  • Numerical optimization (gradient-based methods)

  • Lab automation, HDF5 and large datasets, Linux

We care more about rigor and learning speed than about a perfect match. If you are earlier in your career but have worked with reconstruction data, apply anyway.

What we offer

  • Ownership of the measurement-to-result workflow and the performance of a tool that does not exist anywhere else yet

  • Small team, short feedback loops, real impact on the product

  • Competitive salary for the Dutch market

description:
About AMBOSS

We are a medical education and clinical support platform dedicated to empowering healthcare professionals worldwide to deliver the best possible care.

Founded in Germany, AMBOSS has grown to over 600 team members, with offices in Berlin, Cologne, New York, and Cagliari. Since entering the U.S. medical education market in 2017 with resources for USMLE and shelf exam preparation, AMBOSS has expanded to include point-of-care clinical support and board preparation across multiple specialties. We are now developing a new Qbank for the ABOG Qualifying Examination and are looking for OB-GYN residents and recent residency graduates to help shape this resource.

Position Summary

We are seeking PGY-4 OB-GYN residents or recent graduates for a remote, part-time freelance role developing a new ABOG Qualifying Examination Qbank. You will use your clinical training and board preparation experience to help identify high-yield topics, define what makes a high-quality board-style question, and review questions for exam relevance, difficulty, and educational value. You may also have opportunities to share your insights with multidisciplinary teams (e.g., Commercial, Marketing, AI, Product, and User Research) to help improve medical education and support the responsible use of AI. This role offers a flexible opportunity to explore meaningful nonclinical work alongside your clinical training or practice.

Responsibilities Include

title: Solutions Engineer
description:
Consequential Work. Dedicated People.


About Onebrief

Onebrief builds collaboration and AI-powered workflow software for military planning and operational coordination.

Military planning is complex by nature, requiring teams to coordinate information, people, and decisions across systems and locations. Onebrief brings planning, collaboration, simulation, and AI into one connected environment, helping teams test strategies, adapt to changing conditions, and make decisions with greater clarity when the stakes are real.

We are a distributed team of builders from military, operational, and technology backgrounds who care deeply about improving how important work gets done. Some team members work remotely, while others work directly alongside customers in operational environments around the world.

Founded in 2019, Onebrief is backed by leading investors including General Catalyst, Battery Ventures, Insight Partners, Sapphire Ventures, and Human Capital. Valued at more than $2 billion, we continue to invest in product innovation, AI capabilities, and team growth.

Why This Role Exists

As a Solutions Engineer at Onebrief, you work where mission, engineering, and compliance meet.

You'll own technical solution design and deployment readiness, translating customer requirements into secure, scalable deployment architectures. You'll partner with Platform Engineering, SRE, and our Cybersecurity team to validate infrastructure, configure environments, resolve technical blockers, and successfully transition solutions into production.

Youâll work with our go-to-market and customer facing teams to meet with planners, operations officers, and network owners to understand how they work today. Youâll help show them what that work looks like in Onebrief, and then you'll make it real.

You connect a staff's planning problem to a live, accredited Onebrief deployment.

What You'll Do

Core responsibilities:

  • Run technical discovery. With Sales and Engineering, map a staff's current workflow and pain points, specifically focusing on their technical constraints: networks, hosting, identity, and integration requirements, especially in multi-network environments.

  • Lead deployment engineering. Coordinate the technical delivery of new deployments, including infrastructure validation, network configuration checks, and system readiness verification. Write code to configure new deployments and support new environments.

  • Support accreditation. Help create and review security documentation, including STIG checklists and ATO artifacts, alongside our cybersecurity team so deployments are accredited on the customer's timeline.

  • Align stakeholders. Get technical stakeholders on both sides to agree on requirements, constraints, and tradeoffs, so customers see value sooner. Ensure those technical requirements are properly translated into contract deliverables.

  • Scope integrations. Design how Onebrief Connect fits into a command's ecosystem: APIs, data pipelines, Foundry and Maven Smart System, CUOPS tools, and dashboards.

  • Deliver tailored demos. Lead technical demonstrations and solution validation, partnering with Sales and customer-facing teams to demonstrate Onebrief's technical capabilities, deployment architecture, security posture, and integration options.

  • Run pilot deployments. Configure Onebrief in new and untested environments to enable limited uses in support of new sales.

  • Turn field experience into patterns. Convert what you learn in deployments into structured workflows and reusable implementation patterns, and feed clear requirements to Product and Engineering.

  • Travel 30â50% of the time to customer sites and exercises.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Top Secret clearance with SCI eligibility.

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

  • 4+ years in solutions engineering, infrastructure or deployment engineering, or forward-deployed engineering, working closely with go-to-market and operational teams

  • Experience in DoW environments and their security and compliance requirements (RMF, STIGs, ICD 503)

  • Strong expertise with containers (Docker) and orchestration (Kubernetes)

  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud) and on-premises virtualization (RHEL)

  • Solid understanding of networking concepts and protocols, and of security best practices for highly sensitive environments

  • Strong presence with customers, from action officers to senior leaders, and clear, concise writing

  • Calm under pressure, and focused on forward motion

Preferred Qualifications

  • Proficiency in a scripting language (Python, Go, or Bash)

  • Infrastructure as code (Terraform, CloudFormation, Ansible)

  • Monitoring and logging tools (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, Datadog) and service mesh (Istio, Linkerd)

  • Experience as a military planner or staff officer, or with mission command systems, Foundry, or Maven Smart System

  • Presales experience, including building and delivering demos

Any unsolicited resumes, including those submitted to hiring managers, shall be deemed the property of Onebrief.

title: Account Executive - Enterprise - Healthcare
description:
About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role
We’re looking for an experienced, motivated Enterprise Account Executive to drive ElevenLabs’ growth across Healthcare: the health systems, hospitals, clinics, health plans, and life sciences companies people trust with their health and their families’ care. These organizations win or lose on trust and access at massive scale, under some of the most demanding regulatory standards anywhere.

Our ideal candidate learns fast, closes well from a warm introduction, and is passionate about AI voice technology. You’ll act as a strategic partner to organizations reimagining how they serve patients, members, and clinicians, safely and at scale.

In this role you will:

  • Focus on prospecting and landing net-new customers to expand the market footprint that ElevenLabs has in the Healthcare industry

  • Balance a diverse pipeline of large health systems that require a white-glove experience with community hospitals, clinics, and regional providers that require speed to close

  • Identify where conversational AI can drive growth, automation, or cost efficiency in patient-facing and internal workflows, such as scheduling and reminders, after-hours coverage, benefits and claims status, patient intake and outreach, and HCP support

  • Stay current on the conversational AI landscape, including competitive solutions, build-vs-buy dynamics, and emerging trends in healthcare AI governance

  • Develop and execute account strategies across the whole buying group (Patient Access and Contact Center Operations, Digital and Product, IT and Clinical Informatics, and Compliance, Privacy, Legal, and InfoSec), landing with one high-impact use case and expanding across facilities and service lines

  • Partner closely with Forward Deployed Engineers to solution high-impact use cases, manage a successful Proof of Value, scope integrations with the EHR, claims, and telephony systems customers already run, and set them up to scale in production

  • Partner closely with Legal teams to drive strategic, fast-moving negotiations, including BAAs

  • Serve as a trusted advisor on generative AI and voice, and share what you learn in the field to sharpen our Healthcare positioning, messaging, and references

Requirements

  • 7+ years of quota-carrying enterprise sales experience in SaaS or technology, ideally with exposure to AI, generative AI, LLM-based products, or API-driven platforms

  • Healthcare experience (health systems, hospitals, payers, life sciences, health tech) is preferred but not required. We weigh demonstrated adaptability and fast ramp in a new industry heavily

  • Proven success closing six-and-seven figure deals and managing complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles

  • Proven ability to take a warm introduction through discovery, Proof of Value, and procurement to close

  • Experience selling to both technical buyers (IT, product, and engineering) and business buyers (patient access, operations, digital), and to privacy and compliance gatekeepers, translating complex technology into business value

  • Adept at deeply understanding a customer’s business and translating ElevenLabs’ capabilities into solutions that deliver against their needs

  • Proficient in enterprise procurement, security review, and legal processes, including HIPAA, BAAs, and PHI data protection reviews, and able to work autonomously as a cross-functional partner

  • Strong executive presence, the ability to build relationships with senior executives, and willingness to travel frequently for onsite client visits and conferences

  • High EQ, self-aware, and curious. Low ego and hands-on, comfortable running your own prospecting and deals

  • Comfort in an early-stage, high-growth environment, where ambiguity is the norm and the state of play changes rapidly

  • Passion for voice and conversational AI and how it can unlock transformative value for customers

Location
 This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere in the United States, however the ability to operate in EST, CST, or PST timezones is required. There is a preference for candidates to be based in New York or San Francisco, with the option to work out of our office.

#LI-remote

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

title: Graduate Tax Analyst
description:
Learn tax from scratch. Then help rebuild how it's done.

No prior tax knowledge needed. We'll teach you the tax and fund your professional qualification.

What you bring is the other half: SQL, code, and hands-on experience using AI workflows to turn large datasets into clear answers. Because tax, it turns out, is a data problem with deadlines.

And you'll join while the tax function is still being built, so the tools you make become part of how it runs.

 

The Job

Taptap Send moves billions of dollars every month across 100 countries. Every new market and product line brings tax questions, and you'll help answer them.

  • Plan for what's next: work with our Director of Finance and tax specialists on tax planning for new markets and products, and build your own view of how tax works across the business.

  • Follow the data: map how tax data moves from our systems to our returns, and spot where it could be faster, more accurate or better controlled.

  • Fix what you find: turn those findings into a plan and take a leading role delivering it, using AI and better data so manual steps become the exception.

  • Ship tools people use: build tax tools on live financial data, from first idea to everyday use.

  • Deliver the returns: work with our tax specialists on returns and reporting across our markets, on processes you helped improve.

 

Why you'll want it

A qualification, paid for. Learn tax on the job from specialists across multiple disciplines, with your professional qualification funded.

The whole function, not one corner. Planning, launches, processes and returns: you'll see how tax works across a high-growth fintech, start to finish.

Real outcomes, early. We hire for potential, not years of experience. On a lean, talent-dense team, you own real work early and take on more as soon as you're ready.

A CV with both halves. You'll come out knowing tax, and knowing how to build the AI-enabled systems behind it in a regulated business.

 

Is this you?

You have, or are on track for, a first-class degree in a numerate subject (or equivalent experience). You're graduating in 2026 or 2027, or you're up to two years into your career.

You write strong SQL plus Python or similar, and you've used AI workflows on large datasets in practice.

You think in systems, and you can explain technical work to people who don't write code.

And you're genuinely curious about tax, with the drive to qualify.

 

Never studied tax? That's the part we teach. Send your CV, even if it isn't polished yet.

title: Compliance Data & IA Specialist - Alternance
description:
🦊 À propos de Green-Got

Green-Got est une institution financière française qui permet à chacun de choisir ce que son argent finance. Nous construisons l’infrastructure financière du monde qui vient, au service de la transition écologique.

Depuis janvier 2026, Green-Got est un Établissement de Paiement agréé par l’ACPR, supervisé par la Banque de France. Nous proposons un compte de paiement associé à une carte, ainsi qu’une gamme de placements financiers pour investir dans les entreprises de la transition (assurance-vie, produits structurés, PER, Private Equity).

La Compliance est au cœur de ce modèle. C’est le socle de notre crédibilité, vis-à-vis de nos membres, du régulateur et de la mission que nous portons.

Lieu : Paris (75) · Présence au bureau : minimum 4 jours par semaine · Contrat : Alternance de 24 mois · Niveau : Master 1 · Poste à pourvoir : janvier ou février 2027

Chez Green-Got, la Compliance est un pilier stratégique et un levier de croissance durable. Nous voulons la faire évoluer vite, avec les bons outils, les bonnes personnes et une vraie culture de la donnée.

Nous recherchons un profil hybride, capable de concilier la rigueur du traitement opérationnel et la puissance de la data. Ce poste s’adresse à une personne curieuse et engagée, qui veut appliquer ses compétences techniques à des sujets de conformité qui comptent vraiment.

Au-delà des acquis académiques, c’est la posture qui fera la différence : autonomie, initiative sincère et envie d’avancer dans un environnement qui bouge vite.

Tu es méthodique sur le fond et réactif dans l’exécution. Les deux à la fois.

Une mission au service de notre raison d’être

Chez Green-Got, la transition écologique n’est pas un sujet annexe. C’est notre mission principale : permettre à chacun de choisir ce que son argent finance, et orienter nos placements vers les entreprises qui font avancer la transition. La Compliance est ce qui rend cette mission crédible et durable. En rejoignant l’équipe, tu rejoins une entreprise dont le cœur de métier est là.

Tes missions

Tes missions

Au sein d’une équipe Compliance à taille humaine (nous sommes 5 aujourd’hui), tu es en interface directe avec les équipes Customer Care, Produit, Tech, Data, nos partenaires et nos membres.

Nos missions vont évoluer avec notre offre et avec une année 2027 qui s’annonce très dynamique. Le descriptif de ce poste bougera donc certainement, mais l’objectif restera le même : rester conforme à nos obligations tout en faisant avancer l’entreprise.

Opérations et gestion des dossiers Compliance (60 %)

  • Garant de l’entrée en relation : tu analyses la cohérence des dossiers KYC et prépares les décisions de validation ou de refus des membres.

  • Contrôle et vigilance des flux : tu suis les transactions, qualifies les alertes et proposes les mesures conservatoires à prendre.

  • Déclarations de soupçon (TRACFIN) : tu participes à la préparation et à la transmission des déclarations, sous la supervision de l’équipe.

  • Relation avec les membres et les partenaires : tu réponds aux questions de conformité avec un discours clair, pédagogique et ferme.

IA appliquée, réglementation et formation (40 %)

  • Réglementation IA (AI Act) : tu maîtrises les obligations du règlement européen sur l’intelligence artificielle et tu es responsable de leur mise en place au sein de la Compliance (et tout Green-Got). Cela inclut l’inventaire de nos usages IA, leur classification par niveau de risque, la documentation et les contrôles associés.

  • Contribution au cerveau de Green-Got : tu participes à la construction et à l’alimentation de la base de connaissance partagée de l’entreprise, pour que les équipes et les outils IA s’appuient sur les mêmes informations, procédures et règles.

  • Applications internes : tu repères les process de la Compliance qui gagneraient à être outillés, puis tu participes à la conception de ces applications avec l’équipe Data & IA.

  • Skills Library : tu formalises les méthodes de travail de l’équipe (analyse de dossiers, rédaction de rapports, contrôles) sous forme de compétences réutilisables par les équipes et les agents IA, et tu les tiens à jour à chaque évolution de notre offre.

  • Assistants et agents IA : tu participes à leur paramétrage et à leur amélioration, et tu mesures leur fiabilité avant toute mise en production.

  • Formation de l’équipe : tu es le relais IA de la Compliance. Tu accompagnes tes collègues sur les outils et les bons usages, tu partages tes méthodes et tu aides chacun à monter en compétences, à son rythme.

  • Veille et expérimentation : tu explores les nouveaux usages de l’IA dans un cadre maîtrisé et tu partages tes conclusions avec l’équipe.

  • Maîtrise de nos outils internes : Notion est au cœur de notre fonctionnement. Tu le maîtrises et tu contribues à le faire évoluer pour l’équipe.

Ta montée en compétences

Les premiers mois sont consacrés à une immersion forte dans la production, pour bien comprendre nos process avant de les automatiser. Nous te donnons un cadre clair pour gagner en autonomie :

  • Mois 1 : comprendre Green-Got, notre application et les fondamentaux de la Compliance.

  • Mois 2 : maîtriser les outils et les sujets opérationnels.

  • Mois 3 : être autonome sur les cas simples, continuer d’apprendre sur les cas complexes.

  • Mois 4 : être pleinement autonome sur l’opérationnel et monter en puissance sur les projets Data & IA et sur la réglementation IA.

Vos compétences

Ton profil

Nous recherchons un esprit agile et curieux, prêt à grandir avec nous. Quelqu’un qui a une véritable passion pour la data, la tech et les enjeux réglementaires, et qui veut voir l’impact concret de son travail sur une infrastructure financière que nous construisons avec conviction.

Tu as une vraie envie de travailler, d’avancer et d’évoluer. Tu es prêt à un rythme soutenu, car la charge de travail peut être importante.

Chez Green-Got, nous sommes rusés, responsables, nous recherchons constamment le progrès, nous allons vite et le collectif passe avant l’individu.

  • Esprit analytique et algorithmique : tu allies une solide culture data (SQL, manipulation de bases de données, intérêt pour les LLM et le prompt engineering) à un esprit d’analyse affûté pour décortiquer les dossiers complexes, qualifier les alertes et détecter les comportements à risque.

  • Curiosité sincère pour la conformité et la réglementation IA: tu n’es peut-être pas juriste, mais comprendre les mécanismes KYC, LCB-FT, IA Act et RGPD t’intéresse vraiment.

  • Intérêt pour la réglementation IA : tu as envie de lire les textes et de les traduire en actions concrètes, qu’il s’agisse de l’AI Act ou des autres obligations qui encadrent nos activités.

  • Autonomie et responsabilité réelle : tu avances avec assurance et respect de tes engagements. Tu identifies les problèmes, tu trouves des solutions et tu prends les rênes de tes sujets sans attendre qu’on te les confie.

  • Force de proposition et d’initiative : ton rôle dépasse l’exécution. Tu questionnes, tu améliores, tu contribues.

  • Rigueur et précision : dans un environnement réglementé, chaque action doit être tracée. Tu ne te contentes jamais de l’à-peu-près.

  • Aisance rédactionnelle, éducative et relationnelle : tu as une plume soignée et tu sais traduire une situation complexe en explications simples.

  • Goût pour la transmission : tu aimes partager tes méthodes et voir tes collègues progresser.

  • Esprit d’équipe : la Compliance se construit collectivement, et le partage d’information brise les silos.

  • Formation : tu démarres un Master 1 (ou une année équivalente en école d’ingénieurs, de commerce ou d’informatique), idéalement avec un ancrage en Data Science, IA, Statistiques, Économétrie ou Droit du numérique.

  • Anglais opérationnel : indispensable pour documenter ton travail et échanger avec l’équipe technique et nos partenaires.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
Blockstream was founded in 2014 by Dr. Adam Back and a group of fellow cryptographers and engineers passionate about Bitcoin and its potential to change the future of finance. We have become a market leader in Bitcoin security and Layer-2 technologies. Our products are designed to make financial systems more efficient, secure, and robust.

We're seeking a Forward Deployed Engineer embedded directly inside customer engineering teams, writing the code, building the tooling, integrations and configurations needed to get Blockstream's products into production. Additionally you ship what you build back into the core product.

Operating within the Consulting Services organization, the Forward Deployed Engineer partners closely with Product Management, Engineering, Enterprise Sales, and Delivery teams to help customers successfully implement and adopt Blockstream's products.

This is not a traditional configuration or support role. You will spend significant time working directly alongside customer engineering, operations, and technology teams, often onsite, to understand complex banking environments, solve technical challenges, and deliver production-ready solutions. As the technical bridge between customers and Blockstream, you will play a critical role in accelerating customer success while providing valuable implementation insights that continuously improve our products and delivery methodology.


What You'll Be Doing (Responsibilities):

Customer Delivery & Implementation

  • AI-first prototyping: Use AI-assisted development to stand up minimum viable solutions or proof of concepts on short turnaround notice, proving Enterprise Product value early in an engagement and hardening the winning prototypes into use case based playbooks.

  • Tech Pre-Sales: Support Enterprise Sales in technical pre-sales, RFP/RFI and security questionnaire responses; contribute to SOW scoping, effort estimation, and scope-change management.

  • Delivery: Own the technical delivery of Blockstream enterprise software from project kickoff through production deployment and post launch support

  • Financial Institutions: Work directly with financial institutions to understand business processes, operational workflows, and technical environments.

  • Configure, deploy, and optimize Blockstream products based on customer requirements and approved solution designs.

  • Success Criteria: Execute implementation planning, system configuration, testing, User Acceptance Testing (UAT), production deployment, and post-go-live support. Define success criteria, milestones and own implementation.

  • Deliver administrator and end-user enablement sessions to ensure successful customer adoption.

  • Enterprise integration: Integrate with core banking and capital-markets systems.

Engineering & Technical Delivery

  • Controlled environments: Deploy into on-premise, network-isolated, and air-gapped banking environments under formal change control, producing the security and audit evidence that compliance and pen-test reviews require.

  • Design and implement integrations between Blockstream enterprise products and customer systems using required integration interfaces and data pipeline technologies.

  • Troubleshoot complex technical, configuration, and integration challenges throughout the implementation lifecycle.

  • Work closely with customer engineering teams to ensure secure, scalable, and production-ready deployments.

  • Develop reusable deployment assets, implementation playbooks, technical documentation, and best practices.

  • Collaborate closely with Engineering to resolve product issues and improve implementation quality.

Customer Collaboration

Embed directly with customer teams to gain a deep understanding of their operating environment and technical challenges.

  • Facilitate technical workshops, architecture discussions, and implementation planning sessions.

  • Act as a trusted technical advisor throughout the implementation lifecycle.

  • Build strong relationships across customer Technology, Operations, Security, and Engineering functions.

Digital Assets Product Improvement Feedback Loop

  • Turn implementation learnings, customer feedback, and product enhancement opportunities into code

  • Identify repeatable deployment patterns across engagements and contribute to standardized implementation methodologies.

  • Partner with Product Management and Engineering to shape the roadmap and improve platform capabilities based on real customer implementations.

  • Help accelerate customer time-to-production through continuous improvement of deployment frameworks and best practices.

     

What We Look for In You (Required Qualifications):

  • 4-8 years of experience in Software Engineering, Forward Deployed Engineering, Solutions Engineering, Professional Services, Technical Consulting, Implementation Engineering, or Enterprise Software Delivery.

  • Proficiency in at least one systems or backend language (e.g. Python, Go, Rust) sufficient to build and ship integrations, tooling and services independently

  • Experience implementing and deploying enterprise software solutions within complex customer environments.

  • Strong understanding of protocol intermediation, enterprise integration patterns, cloud technologies, security fundamentals and modern software architectures.

  • Experience working directly with enterprise customers throughout implementation and deployment projects.

  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.

  • Ability to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions.

  • Comfortable collaborating across Product Management, Engineering, Enterprise Sales, and Consulting teams.

  • Strong customer-facing communication and stakeholder management skills.

  • Self-starter with proven ability to work independently while managing multiple customer engagements.

  • Willingness to travel regularly to customer locations across Switzerland.

  • Excellent English skills are required, German and/or French is strongly preferred.

     

Nice To Haves (Preferred Qualifications):

  • Experience working with financial institutions, like private banking, wealth management, custody, payments, treasury, or capital markets.

  • Background in Bitcoin, blockchain, digital assets, tokenization, or fintech.

  • Experience integrating enterprise software using APIs and modern integration frameworks.

  • Knowledge of cloud platforms, containerized deployments, or infrastructure automation.

  • Familiarity with Layer-2 technologies and digital asset infrastructure.

  • Experience contributing product feedback from customer implementations into engineering roadmaps.

title: Product Engineer, Nino
description:
Overview

CoinTracker is on a mission to unlock everyone's financial potential so they can build the life they want. We started with crypto, building the tax and portfolio tools that millions of users trust to trade digital assets with peace of mind. Nino builds the next layer of financial fluency for our users. Nino is an AI-powered financial operating system that makes comprehensive, expert-level tax and financial planning advice accessible.

More on Nino: Comprehensive tax and financial planning strategies are currently locked behind high AUM fees or require enough wealth to have a family office. We are turning expert judgment into software so we can serve millions. AI is going to redefine how people understand their finances and how tax advice gets delivered. Not in ten years, in 2026. You can help define that, or spend the next few years adapting to rules someone else wrote. Nino sits inside CoinTracker ($100M raised, partnered with Coinbase, TurboTax, H&R Block, and Thomson Reuters) with the autonomy of an early-stage startup and the reach of an established platform.

Your mission

As Product Engineer, you'll own customer problems from the first conversation to a working product. You'll talk to users, shape the idea, design the experience, and build it across the stack. You'll work closely with engineers, design, and our CPAs and Financial Planners to turn complicated financial work into software people can understand and trust.

Your one-year outcomes

  • Customers rely on what you build. You've shipped meaningful features end to end, with evidence that customers use them and find them valuable.

  • More financial work gets done. Workflows you own help households and advisors complete tasks with less manual effort, fewer handoffs, and clearer next steps.

  • The experience holds up. Your features are easy to use and reliable in practice, including when information is missing, an integration fails, or a person needs to step in.

  • We learn and ship faster. You turn ambiguous problems into focused releases, learn from real usage, and use that evidence to decide what to improve next.

What you will do

  • Examples of what you could build:

    • Trading: Help users go from an investment idea to a reviewed trade, with clear approvals, execution status, and visibility into what happened.

    • Strategies: Build ways to discover financial ideas, understand their upside and tradeoffs, explore how they fit a household's situation, and turn a saved strategy into a plan of action.

    • Tax filing: Bring document collection, missing-information requests, CPA review, and filing progress into one clear experience for households and their tax team.

    Across these features, you'll:

    • Own problems from discovery to launch. Talk with customers and financial experts, identify what matters, and decide what to build first.

    • Design the experience. Sketch, prototype, and refine interfaces with our designer. Make complex decisions and workflows feel clear.

    • Build across the stack. Ship interfaces, backend services, integrations, and AI workflows. Follow the problem wherever the implementation takes you.

    • Turn agents into useful products. Build ways for people to understand, review, and approve an agent's work, including workflows that span external tools and websites.

    • Make the whole flow work. Handle incomplete information, interruptions, retries, and human handoffs. Verify that the task actually finished correctly.

    • Use AI tools to ship and iterate. Move quickly, understand and check what you ship, and keep improving it through customer feedback and usage.

What we look for

  • Role-agnostic

    • Opportunity alignment: You want to help households manage complex finances and bring expert tax and financial planning to more people. You're excited to shape a product on a small, early team.

    • High agency: You see what needs doing and take responsibility for it. You can start with an incomplete brief, find the missing information, and make progress.

    • Exceptional collaboration: You make the people around you better: engineers, designers, CPAs, and Financial Planners. You seek feedback, say what you think, and follow through.

    • First-principles thinking: You start with the customer's problem, question assumptions, and can explain why your approach makes sense. You change your mind when the evidence changes.

  • Role-specific

    • Strong engineering fundamentals. You've built and shipped working software, can reason through unfamiliar systems, and care about correctness and maintainability.

    • Product judgment. You can turn an open-ended problem into a useful first release, explain what you left out, and define how you'll know it helped.

    • Design taste. You notice confusing interactions, care about the details, and can explain how your changes improve the experience.

    • You ship your own work. You're comfortable moving between the interface and backend, using AI coding tools thoughtfully, and verifying the result.

    • Bonus: startup, agent, or integration experience. You've built directly with users, worked with browser automation or AI agents, or connected systems that don't fit neatly together.

Prior experience with finance, AI or ML products, or our exact tech stack isn't required. Neither is a particular degree or school. We're interested in what you've built and how you think.

The starting salary for this position is between $140,250 - $207,775 USD. Candidate's location does not impact the posted salary range. The actual compensation offered will be based on a variety of job-related factors including relevant skills, education, and experience. This position also includes equity in CoinTracker and benefits like medical, dental, vision, 401(k), life insurance, and PTO.

title: Account Executive - SMB Sales
description:
At WorkWave, we build innovative software and fintech solutions for the people who keep our world safe, clean, and beautiful, from pest control to lawn care, commercial cleaning to security services. With over 8,000 customers around the globe, our platform helps these hardworking service professionals run and grow their businesses from end to end: from customer acquisition to scheduling, billing, payments, and beyond.

Our vision is simple but powerful: empower the world’s mobile service workers to build a brighter future. And we back that up with decades of experience, a passionate team, and an unwavering commitment to helping our customers thrive.

WorkWave is seeking a results‑driven Account Executive to focus on small and growing Pest and Lawn service businesses. This role is ideal for a motivated sales professional who is eager to build strong relationships, master a consultative sales process, and help entrepreneurs transform the way they run and grow their service businesses.

Why Join Now:

We’re at an exciting moment in our growth journey. With the launch of Wavelytics, our new AI-powered analytics suite, and continued momentum in integrated payments, we’re unlocking new ways to deliver value to our customers, and new opportunities for our team. WorkWave operates in a field service management market that’s accelerating due to global trends in automation, sustainability, and digital transformation. Joining now means getting in early as we scale to meet massive demand and lead the future of service software.

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Learn quickly and build a strong understanding of our platform and its value for small, growing Pest and Lawn service businesses with 4-9 employees
  • Lead online demos that excite and inspire stakeholders to envision a future state that drives growth, efficiency, and digital transformation
  • Own your territory like a “CEO”. Manage the sales cycle from lead generation to closing with a hunter mentality that balances a consistent cadence of outbound activity and a quick response to inbound MQLs
  • Master the sales process - conducting discovery, scoping, and proof of concept to create a seamless experience for prospects
  • Leverage best‑in‑class tools like Salesforce, SalesLoft, and 6Sense to manage activity, build accurate forecasts, and a strong predictable pipeline
  • Stay focused on results - hitting weekly KPIs (demos booked, demos held, 3x pipeline) and closing deals every week to exceed quota

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:

  • The ability to take initiative and work independently, confidently manage your pipeline, prospect proactively, lead demos that inspire, and close deals efficiently
  • Strong communication skills that combine active listening, thoughtful negotiation, and consultative selling to connect with and influence stakeholders
  • Excellent organizational skills with the ability to juggle multiple deals at once and manage quick turnarounds without missing a beat
  • A positive, can-do attitude with a natural talent for building authentic relationships and earning trust quickly
  • 1-3 years of experience in a closing sales role within SMB markets
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in a SaaS SMB Account Executive role
  • Must be within a commutable distance to our Holmdel, NJ office

Compensation

In our dedication to salary transparency, we provide a compensation range for sales roles, which is $65,000 in addition to uncapped commission. The final offer will be dependent on various factors, including the candidate's qualifications, relevant experience, and the organization's budget. Our Talent Acquisition team will provide more information about the compensation package for this position during the interview process.

Additional Information

WHAT YOU SHOULD KNOW ABOUT US:

• We are laid back but buttoned up. We offer a casual work environment and remote work flexibility and have a passion for developing creative, innovative best in class solutions that directly contribute to the success of our customers

• We care deeply and deliver service and solutions that make a real difference in the lives of our clients and their businesses

• We openly accept others as they are and build strong partnerships based on trust

• Teamwork and collaboration is key to help our colleagues and customers solve their challenges

• Our team is energetic, fun, naturally inquisitive and eager to make an impact, we invite you to join us!

LOVE WHAT YOU DO, NO MATTER WHERE YOU DO IT:

• Join our Remote-First Global Work Community: WorkWave provides an innovative and dynamic remote-first Global Work Community that encourages growth, creativity, and collaboration. title: Product Owner, Payments and Infrastructure
description:
About Flex

Flex is building the AI-native private bank for super premium, closely held business owners.

We are re-architecting the entire financial system for entrepreneurs. From the first dollar a business earns to how that value compounds, moves, and is ultimately spent in real life. Banking, credit, payments, personal finance, financial operations, all rebuilt from the ground up as a single intelligent system.

Since launching publicly in September 2023, we have scaled from zero to nine-figure annualized revenue with a clear path to profitability by late 2026. We move fast, ship relentlessly, and operate with extreme ownership.

Our customers are affluent business owners with $3M to $200M in revenue. The backbone of the economy and one of the most underserved segments in finance. We are replacing the outdated banks and fragmented tools they are stuck with. The opportunity is a roughly $1T+ revenue market hiding in plain sight. We are building toward $100B+ in enterprise value by delivering a product that is fundamentally better, not incrementally improved.

Flex has raised $100M+ in equity and $300M+ in debt.

What we hold ourselves to: mission-critical problems, high bar low ego, speed over comfort, enduring impact.

Locations: Remote. Open to candidates in Canada, Mexico, the United States, Brazil, and Colombia.

The Role

You will build Flex's payments infrastructure. You will lead our vendor strategy across acquiring, international money movement, and partner banks. You will architect how Flex orchestrates multiple payment providers across bank partners, processors, and international rails into a single elegant customer experience. And you will be the product partner on our transition from operating on partner licenses to operating on our own money transmitter licenses, which is a foundational shift in how Flex works.

This seat requires someone who can hold a serious technical conversation with a Tier 1 bank, who has personally implemented payment rails at meaningful scale, and who can translate vendor selection into clear product decisions. The candidate we want has lived through at least one major payments transition (processor change, license expansion, or rails buildout) and knows what to watch for.

You do not need to be a lawyer. You do need to understand what the operational shift into a forward thinking strategy around money movement means, and be able to communicate the now program, the in-between, and the future program clearly to the rest of the company.

What you will do

Own major Tier 1 bank partner implementations and the broader bank partner strategy.

Architect the multi-provider payments stack across acquiring, international money movement, and partner banks. Tomorrow it means more rails, more corridors, more direct integrations.

Lead vendor selection across new payment rails as Flex scales domestically and internationally.

Partner to deliver our MTL acquisition process. Own the product implications of the partner-licensed-to-directly-licensed transition. Translate the operational change for the rest of the company.

Build the framework for international money movement across multiple corridors. Pair payment providers thoughtfully so the customer experience is elegant and the vendor risk is balanced.

Represent Flex in technical and commercial negotiations with the largest financial institutions in the world.

Partner with engineering on the implementation cadence. We have a small but growing payments pod and you will help us scale it as the surface area grows.

What you will need

4 to 9+ years of payments-specific product experience. Ready to build a function from the ground up.

You have personally owned vendor relationships and technical implementations with top-tier payment providers. You know the difference between what a vendor sells and what they actually deliver.

Money transmitter licensing transition experience is strongly preferred. If you have lived through a company going from partner-licensed to directly licensed, we want to talk to you. If you have not, the right candidate can still close on this gap. We can teach the MTL specifics. We cannot teach the judgment.

You can hold a technical conversation about ACH, wire, card rails, real-time payments, and cross-border money movement without needing translation.

You have negotiated with at least one Tier 1 bank or payment network and can walk us through what you learned.

Nice to have

Direct experience working with or alongside any of the following will help you ramp faster. None of these are required. The more of them you have touched, the more productive you will be on day one.

Tier 1 bank partners. JPMorgan Chase, Goldman Sachs, Wells Fargo, Citi, or comparable institutions on a real fintech partnership.

Card processors and issuing platforms. Marqeta, Lithic, Stripe Issuing, Adyen Issuing, Galileo, Highnote, Checkout.com.

Cross-border rails and international money movement. Airwallex, Wise, Nium, Currencycloud, Remitly, WorldRemit.

Bank infrastructure and BaaS platforms. Unit, Modern Treasury, Increase, Treasury Prime, Column, Lead, Synctera.

Compensation

Team & Locations

We hire exceptional people who want to build hard things and see their work matter immediately. Roles are available in: San Francisco, Miami, New York, and fully remote.

Flex Fuels Ambition.

The Role

We are looking for product owners who are excited to be part of our early story and help us build a category leading company. You will learn quickly, reflect on "the way the world should work", own outcomes, and drive the creation of financial products and experiences to help our customers reach their full potential. You should have a strong sense of ownership and enjoy taking projects from inception to release. As an early employee, you’ll be working with a nimble team of committed and talented employees and having a large, long-term impact on Flex products and culture.

We are open to candidates from Canada, Mexico, the United States, Brazil and Colombia.

What you'll do

  • Develop and own Flex's "Growth engine" across "Infinite wedges". Flex acquires customers in many unique ways that meet business owners where they are. We build software to make these experiences extremely unique. You'll own our growth - end to end - for the full "multi-product" experience.
  • Drive the enhancement of financial services and products, including mobile apps, online account management tools, and virtual payment solutions. Continuously improve the user experience and add features to meet changing customer needs.
  • Collaborate with internal stakeholders to identify opportunities within the organization's operational processes. Develop internal financial solutions, such as automated reporting tools, data analytics platforms, and workflow optimization systems, to increase efficiency and streamline operations.
  • Work closely with compliance and legal to ensure that all products adhere to relevant financial regulations and industry standards. Mitigate potential risks through robust product design and implementation. Stay up-to-date with changes in industry regulations and security protocols.
  • Conduct user research and market analysis to understand customer preferences, pain points, and emerging trends. Utilize these insights to inform product development decisions.
  • Partner with engineering throughout the development lifecycle. Provide clear and detailed product requirements, prioritize features, and ensure the timely delivery of high-quality solutions. Implement necessary measures to safeguard customer data and ensure compliance with relevant laws.
  • Utilize data analytics and performance metrics to assess product performance, identify areas for improvement, and make data-driven decisions to optimize products.
  • Work closely with customer support teams to address customer inquiries, feedback, and issues related to products. Continuously strive to improve customer satisfaction and retention.
  • Develop and communicate a clear product roadmap and strategy. Align the product vision with the Flex's overall objectives.

What you'll need

  • Can run sprints.
  • Extremely high trajectory and horsepower. Flex is a place for people who want to own outcomes.
  • Proven experience as a Product Owner or similar role at a startup with a focus on financial products. We bring SaaS platform principles to traditional FinTech.
  • Solid knowledge of credit risk assessment, lending processes, and banking operations a nice to have.
  • Familiarity with compliance standards, regulations, and security protocols relevant to the credit and banking sectors a nice to have. Willingness to become an expert is a must.
  • Excellent communication, translation, collaboration, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Analytical mindset with the ability to leverage data and market insights to inform product decisions.
  • Proficiency in using product management tools and platforms to manage the product backlog and track progress.
  • Passion for innovation, customer-centricity, and continuous improvement in product development.

What we offer

  • A visionary founding team with elite backgrounds and substantial industry experience.
  • A substantial Series B round, providing ample growth and opportunities. You're still an early employee. Today is still day 1.
  • A culture that supports remote work and values connection through semi-annual offsites.
  • Support from leading Silicon Valley venture capitalists and industry insiders.
  • An attractive compensation package, including comprehensive benefits and perks.

Compensation

Additional Information

Interested? We'd love to hear from you

At Flex, we value passion, determination, and honesty. Even if you don't fully match the job specifics, we encourage you to apply. Unusual career paths and unique skills can help you stand out. We believe diversity drives our success.

Why Join Us

Build something generational — Capture the full lifecycle of money for ambitious business owners.

Work on real money, real risk — Payments, credit, and banking at serious scale.

Solve hard problems — AI, underwriting, compliance, and global finance from first principles.

True ownership — Small teams, high trust, real accountability.

Founder-level exposure — Direct access to leadership, customers, and investors.

High bar, high taste — Move fast without cutting corners.

Elite peers — People here are builders, not tourists.

This isn't traditional customer support. You're a trusted advisor serving our high-net-worth members. We're committed to delivering premium, white-glove service with an uncompromising standard for quality. You'll operate as an autonomous problem-solver, handling complex fintech scenarios with precision and sophistication, including cross-functional troubleshooting, compliance coordination, and fraud detection.

✅ What You’ll Do

  • Handle complex customer issues across banking, credit, and payments via email, chat, and phone with precision and clarity: requiring thorough investigation across multiple internal systems before providing answers that meet our quality standards
  • Guide VIP and high-revenue accounts through multi-step processes with excellence (document verification, account setup, feature troubleshooting) maintaining the highest standards of care and service quality
  • Handle sensitive scenarios with discretion and expertise: frozen accounts, disputed transactions, application denials, and compliance-related communications—executing each with precision and professional judgment
  • Coordinate with engineering, underwriting, risk, and compliance teams to resolve multi-stakeholder issues
  • File detailed bug reports and test new features in staging environments
  • Create and update documentation when you encounter process gaps
  • Qualify high-value sales leads with rigor and route to appropriate account executives, ensuring every introduction meets our quality standards and reflects our commitment to excellence

⚡️ What Makes You a Great Fit

  • Clear, professional communication: your written/spoken English is flawless. You can explain complex fintech concepts to a non-technical customer. You write concise Slack messages and detailed Linear tickets.
  • High ownership: you don't wait for someone to tell you what to do. If you see a broken process, you fix it or document the gap.
  • Investigative mindset: you dig into issues until you understand the root cause. You don't just relay information; you synthesize it.
  • Technical fluency: You learn new software fast. You can navigate Zendesk, Salesforce, Linear, Slack, Notion, and Google Sheets without someone holding your hand.
  • Exceptional judgment: you can read between the lines. You know when a customer is confused vs. trying to game the system. You escalate the right things at the right time.
  • Emotional resilience: you stay calm when customers are frustrated, systems are down, or priorities shift mid-shift.

Why This Role Is Worth It!

  • You'll learn more in 6 months than most people learn in 3 years. Fintech moves fast, and you'll be at the center of product launches, compliance changes, and operational challenges.
  • You'll work with a world-class team. Smart, driven, low-ego people who get stuff done.
  • You'll have real influence. You're not just a ticket-taker. You'll shape how we support customers, build processes, and scale the team.
  • You'll work remotely with autonomy. No micromanagement. You own your shift.

👀 What We’re Looking For:

  • Fluent English (written and spoken at a professional level—you'll be the voice of Flex)
  • 2+ years in fintech or financial services customer support (ideally at a startup or high-growth company where you wore multiple hats)
  • Availability to work nights and weekends (Local and/or US business hours)
  • Experience with Zendesk, Salesforce, or similar CRM tools

Strongly Preferred

  • Experience with banking-as-a-service platforms (Unit, Synapse, Treasury Prime, etc.)
  • Prior exposure to fraud detection, KYC/AML processes, or financial compliance
  • You've worked in a role where you created documentation or improved processes
  • You've supported B2B SaaS or fintech products (not consumer support)

Final compensation within this range will be based on experience, qualifications, and interview performance. This position is also eligible for equity compensation. Flex offers medical, dental and vision insurance, paid time off, and a 401(k) plan. Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.
