title: AWS Cloud Solutions Architect
description:
As a Senior AWS Cloud Solutions Architect, you will be the technical lead on our most complex engagements, from assessment and mobilization to large-scale migration and modernization. You will report to an Engineering Manager based in Europe and lead distributed teams of US- and Budapest-based engineers. You will also work closely with colleagues in our AI/ML and Application Development practices.



What you'll be doing:

  • Lead the technical delivery of complex, high-impact migration and modernization engagements, including AWS Migration Acceleration Program (MAP) assessments and mobilization.

  • Lead technical discovery and design multi-service, cloud-native AWS architectures that turn business goals into scalable blueprints.

  • Technically lead teams of 1â4 engineers, and manage the technical roadmap of 2â3 engagements in parallel.

  • Own technical design decisions within project scope. Resolve technical disagreements and handle scope conversations with clients professionally.

  • Represent Client in customers sessions, including executive-level conversations and joint sessions with AWS stakeholders.

  • Spend around 25% of your time on pre-sales: discovery, solution design and co-selling with AWS account teams in North America.

  • Resolve high-risk technical blockers and escalations, including critical production incidents.

  • Adapt to changing delivery expectations and keep engagements on track under uncertainty.

  • Build architectural guardrails, reusable frameworks and components that raise quality across the practice.

  • Coach engineers and share knowledge through internal sessions, workshops, whitepapers and technical evangelism.

  • Be the go-to expert in one or more domains, such as MSSQL Server, PostgreSQL, EKS, VMware, data, security or networking.

  • Help shape our technical offerings and accelerators in line with market and AWS trends.



What you bring:

  • 8+ years in infrastructure or cloud engineering, including 5+ years designing and delivering on AWS.

  • A proven track record of leading at least two large-scale cloud migrations end to end.

  • Hands-on database migration experience with MSSQL Server, Oracle or PostgreSQL.

  • AWS Certified Solutions Architect â Professional.

  • In-depth knowledge of core AWS services, including:

    • Compute and containers: EC2, Lambda, ECS, EKS

    • Storage and databases: S3, RDS, EFS, EBS

    • Networking and integration: VPC, API Gateway, CloudFront, SNS, SQS

    • Security: IAM, Security Hub, GuardDuty, KMS, AWS Private CA

    • Operations and migration: CloudWatch, AWS Application Migration Service

  • Strong Infrastructure as Code skills. Terraform is preferred; CloudFormation, AWS CDK or Ansible are also welcome.

  • Hands-on experience building and running CI/CD pipelines with GitHub Actions, GitLab, Bitbucket or similar.

  • Experience running containerized workloads with Docker and Kubernetes or EKS.

  • Strong networking knowledge: TCP/IP, DNS, load balancers, firewalls and VPN, plus AWS networking services such as VPC, Route 53, ELB and CloudFront.

  • Strong security knowledge: IAM, least privilege, access control, endpoint security and data encryption.

  • Excellent problem-solving and communication skills. You are confident with executives and engineering teams alike.

  • Comfort working in a distributed team, with a few hours of daily overlap with Central European Time.

  • A bachelor's degree in Computer Science, IT or a related field, or equivalent experience.


Nice to have:

  • Hands-on experience with AWS MAP phases: Assess, Mobilize, and Migrate & Modernize.

  • Migrations from VMware, on-premises data centers, Azure or GCP.

  • Experience with AI-assisted migration and modernization tooling, such as AWS Transform.

  • AWS Specialty certifications, such as Security or Advanced Networking.

title: Fullstack DevOps Engineer (Trust and Identity)
description:
Fullstack DevOps Engineer

In a technically exciting and fast-evolving environment, you will help us build digital trust products for organizations. Our team enables the use of verifiable information in business processes: eID, verifiable credentials, organization identity, KYB, digital signatures, PDF validation, trust chains, and secure onboarding flows.

Many trust, verification, and compliance processes are still manual, fragmented, and costly. We want to change that by building simple, secure, and easy-to-integrate products that allow organizations to verify information, trace it back to an authentic source, and create better user experiences for their customers and partners.

As a Fullstack DevOps Engineer, you will design, build, and operate backend services, APIs, cloud infrastructure, databases, and selected frontend capabilities for these products. You will work closely with frontend engineers, product owners, business stakeholders, UX specialists, and ecosystem partners to turn complex trust and compliance topics into reliable production services.

What impact will you have?

  • Build and operate backend services and APIs using Java, Kotlin, and Spring Boot.

  • Design secure, scalable, and maintainable solutions for eID, verification, onboarding, KYB, and compliance-related products.

  • Work with AWS services, databases, CI/CD pipelines, observability, and infrastructure automation.

  • Model and manage data across relational and/or NoSQL databases with a focus on reliability, traceability, and performance.

  • Integrate frontend applications with robust APIs, authentication, authorization, and secure data flows.

  • Contribute to frontend features where needed using modern JavaScript/TypeScript frameworks.

  • Take end-to-end DevOps ownership: from implementation and automated testing to deployment, monitoring, incident handling, and continuous improvement.

  • Help the team build market-driven products that create real value, not just technical functionality.


Must-haves:

  • Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, software engineering, or a related field, or equivalent working experience.

  • 5 years of professional experience in backend or fullstack software engineering.

  • Strong hands-on experience with Java and/or Kotlin.

  • Solid experience building services with Spring Boot.

  • Experience designing and integrating REST APIs and distributed backend systems.

  • Practical experience with AWS cloud services.

  • Good knowledge of relational and/or NoSQL databases, data modelling, and query performance.

  • Experience with CI/CD, automated testing, Git-based workflows, and production operations.

  • Basic frontend experience with JavaScript/TypeScript and a modern framework such as Vue.js, React, or Angular.

  • Ability to work in an agile, international, and cross-functional DevOps team.

  • Excellent written and spoken English.


Nice-to-haves:

  • Experience with identity, authentication, authorization, OAuth2, OIDC, eID, digital signatures, onboarding, compliance, or regulated B2B products.

  • Knowledge of verifiable credentials, wallets, trust chains, PKI, certificates, or related digital trust concepts.

  • Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, CloudFormation, CDK, or similar infrastructure-as-code tooling.

  • Experience with event-driven architectures, messaging, queues, or asynchronous processing.

  • Experience with observability tooling, logging, metrics, tracing, and alerting.

  • Experience with frontend architecture, design systems, accessibility, or component libraries.

  • Strong communication skills, pragmatic thinking, and the ability to collaborate with technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Want to know more about the team?

We build products that help organizations use trustworthy and verifiable information in digital processes. Our work focuses on reducing manual verification, improving compliance workflows, and creating secure infrastructure that can be integrated into real business use cases.

You will join a team working on emerging digital trust topics across Switzerland and Europe, including eID, organizational identity, verifiable credentials, Know Your Business processes, digital signatures, PDF validation, and secure onboarding.

We work closely with the market, internal stakeholders, and ecosystem partners to build products that solve concrete problems for organizations.


Want to know more about us?

We are serving the Swiss market as Switzerland’s leading IT & Telecom company. Thus, we are actively driving digitalization and networking, and tapping new paths for our customers and our employees. Our values are spark passion, aim high and stand true.

Since 2019, we have been building up the coolest DevOps Center with a wonderful office at the World Trade Center in the heart of Rotterdam. We are currently recruiting IT passionate professionals who are keen on developing high-quality software, have an agile mindset and appreciate the collaboration with motivated colleagues from all over the world.

What's in it for you?

Work environment

  • Agile way of working, multi-cultural work environment promoting work-life balance

  • Autonomy, flexibility, opportunity and growth

  • Cool office space in the World Trade Center Rotterdam!

  • Are you coming to the office by bike or car? You can park right here at the office

  • Be a part of our events to build a stronger Swisscom community - for example, culture lunches, fun quizzes, game nights and a lot more!

Allowances

  • Full relocation support (Housing, settling in, etc.) for you and your family

  • 200 euros per month Telephone/internet allowance

  • 275 euros per month contribution to health insurance

  • 5 Paid training days and access to Swisscom learning platforms

  • Travel allowance reimbursement

  • 500 euros home office allowance

  • Gym subscription, Tax advice, and language course

  • Salary range: 60,000 to 65,000 euros gross per year including holiday allowance

Leaves policy

  • Work from abroad possibility for one month per year

  • Care, bereavement, maternity and paternity leaves

  • 25 days paid vacation days plus Dutch national holidays

Contract terms

  • To begin with you will receive a fixed term contract (one year), after 6 months of your employment with us, after a feedback meeting with the team, there is a possibility of extending the contract 

  • The salary ranges mentioned in our Job Descriptions are base annual gross salaries including the 8% holiday allowance

title: Content Creator - YouTube
description:
Important: Applications without an intro video will not be considered.


Job Overview

Create engaging YouTube tutorials about software, digital marketing, and AI tools that reach millions of people around the world every month through our YouTube channel, Metics Media.


About us

Metics Media is a small, fully remote team creating high-quality YouTube videos about software, digital marketing, and AI tools for an audience of over 700,000 subscribers. Our mission is simple: to make technology easy to understand and help people get the most out of the tools available to them.

We partner with leading platforms like Shopify, Hostinger, and Squarespace, allowing us to keep our content free and accessible to everyone.

We're now looking for talented, motivated content creators to join our growing team, help us produce even more high-quality videos, and reach millions more people around the world.


What you'll do
  • Research each video's topic and tools in depth, and figure out what to cover and how to present it in a clear, engaging way.
  • Write video scripts and outlines.
  • Record videos, including talking-head and screen recordings. Your face will be visible in your videos.
  • Perform basic video editing tasks and prepare footage for our in-house editor.


What we're looking for
  • Native-level written and spoken English
  • Strong on-camera presentation skills and the ability to communicate clearly and confidently
  • Ability to quickly understand complex topics and explain them clearly to beginners
  • Strong research skills and the ability to verify information before presenting it
  • AI-native and highly proficient with modern AI tools, using them effectively to work faster, improve quality, and maximize productivity
  • High attention to detail and a strong commitment to producing high-quality work
  • Ability to take feedback and continuously improve
  • Reliable, organized, and able to work independently and take ownership of your projects
  • Genuine interest in YouTube, online tools, software, and learning new topics
  • A quiet, dedicated workspace where you can work without interruptions, with room to set up a small studio for recording talking-head videos with minimal background noise
  • Fast internet connection with at least 50 Mbps download and 25 Mbps upload
  • Legal authorization to work in the US or Canada


Nice to have
  • Previous experience creating educational video content
  • Knowledge of topics such as website creation, AI tools, ecommerce, or other areas we regularly create videos about
  • Equipment needed to produce high-quality videos


Working at Metics Media

At Metics Media, you'll have a lot of freedom in how you work. You'll be trusted to structure your own day, manage your projects independently, and take ownership of your work. We're a small, ambitious team with high standards, and we're always looking for ways to improve what we create and how we work.

At the same time, you'll get hands-on support, feedback, and training from people with over 8 years of experience making YouTube videos.


Compensation
  • Base salary: $70,000 USD per year (US) / CA$80,000 per year (Canada)
  • Profit sharing: Earn a percentage of the profit generated by every video you create, paid out quarterly
  • For reference, our current creators have earned an average total compensation (base salary + profit-sharing bonuses) of $85,000 USD in their first year and $155,000 USD in their second year. These figures are based on the past performance of our current creator team and are not guaranteed.


Benefits
  • 15 days of paid vacation per year, plus public holidays
  • 10 paid sick days per year
  • Medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • A 401(k) with employer contributions (US)


How to apply

Applications require a short intro video (max. 5 minutes) and your CV. Click "Apply" for all details.

  • Du stellst eine klare und nachvollziehbare Kommunikation zwischen allen Beteiligten sicher.

  • Du pflegst die Kundenpipeline und hältst alle relevanten Angaben im CRM aktuell.

  • Du dokumentierst Kundenstatus, Gesprächsergebnisse, offene Aufgaben und nächste Schritte.

Du verschickst nicht nur eine Anfrage und hakst die Aufgabe ab. Du behältst im Blick, ob eine Rückmeldung eingeht und wie es anschließend weitergeht. Fehlen Informationen oder ist eine Zuständigkeit unklar, gehst du dem Thema nach.

Du strukturierst deine Aufgaben selbstständig, setzt sinnvolle Prioritäten und betreust mehrere Vorgänge parallel. Wenn sich Verzögerungen oder Probleme abzeichnen, kommunizierst du sie frühzeitig.

Du arbeitest genau und hältst Informationen so fest, dass der aktuelle Stand eines Vorgangs jederzeit nachvollziehbar ist. Mit Kundeninformationen und Unterlagen gehst du verantwortungsbewusst um.

💡 Mitdenken und Lösungen finden

Du arbeitest dich gerne in neue Themen ein, erkennst offene Punkte und bringst Lösungsvorschläge mit. Dein Ziel ist nicht nur, Aufgaben zu erledigen, sondern Abläufe zuverlässig voranzubringen.

Gleichzeitig arbeiten wir in unserer Technologie-Sparte an der Weiterentwicklung und dem Ausbau der Heartbeat-Software, um Kunden weltweit mit dem Strommarkt zu vernetzen und so immer den günstigsten und saubersten Stromtarif anbieten zu können.

Hast du Lust, die Energierevolution mit uns anzugehen? Dann bewirb dich jetzt und werde Teil unserer Mission!

title: Design Engineer (m/w/d), Teil- oder Vollzeit, Remote
description:
Über AZAV Pilot

Unsere Vision: Jede(r) sollte lehren und lernen können.

Mit AZAV Pilot können sich Bildungsanbieter in der Erwachsenenbildung auf das konzentrieren, was wirklich zählt: fantastische Kurse & Coachings für ihre Kundinnen und Kunden anzubieten, anstatt im Bürokratiesumpf zu versinken.
Wir entwickeln das Betriebssystem für alles rund um die Verwaltung der Teilnehmenden, die Dokumentation von Anwesenheit und Klassenbuch sowie das Qualitätsmanagement.

Wir sind profitabel, 100 % bootstrapped und suchen zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt einen Design Engineer (m/w/d). Wenn du es liebst, Probleme tief zu verstehen und gemeinsam mit Kunden Lösungen zu entwickeln, die du dann auch selbst im Frontend umsetzt, bist du bei uns richtig!

Die Stelle ist in Teil- oder Vollzeit (mindestens 30h / Woche) remote, mit der Möglichkeit, jederzeit in unserem Büro in Berlin-Charlottenburg zu arbeiten.

Deine Aufgaben

Bisher kümmert sich unser CPO Jakob neben seinen anderen Aufgaben selbst um das Design der Plattform. Jetzt suchen wir eine Person, die das ganz übernimmt und den Look & Feel unseres Produkts auf das nächste Level hebt.

Du arbeitest strukturiert und analytisch? Du machst gerne Research, testest Prototypen und kannst Anforderungen gemeinsam mit unseren Backend-Entwicklern umsetzen? Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig! Wir suchen zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt einen Design Engineer für unser Product Team.

Konkret verantwortest du Folgendes:

  • Du sprichst mit den Nutzer:innen unseres Produkts und findest heraus, wo es hakt.

  • Du machst aus Research klare Problemstellungen, Personas und Journeys.

  • Du baust Prototypen und testest sie mit echten Nutzer:innen.

  • Du kommunizierst Anforderungen für das Backend nachvollziehbar an die anderen Entwickler.

  • Du programmierst Flows und Interfaces für Web und Mobile.

  • Du machst Designentscheidungen im Team nachvollziehbar und stehst für gute UX ein.

Qualifikation

  • 3+ Jahre Erfahrung als Frontend Entwickler

  • 3+ Jahre Erfahrung in UX/UI- oder Product Design, idealerweise bei B2B-Software oder SaaS

  • Erfahrung mit dem Double Diamond, User Interviews und Usability-Tests

  • Fähigkeit, Unsicherheit produktiv zu strukturieren, sowie eine hohe Eigenverantwortung und Selbstorganisation

  • Sicherheit in Design Tools und die Fähigkeit, Anforderungen eigenständig in Code umzusetzen

  • Lust auf eine komplexe Fachdomäne

  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse (Mindestens Niveau C1)

Schön, aber kein Muss

  • Erfahrung mit Verwaltungssoftware oder im Bildungs- und Sozialbereich

  • Erfahrung mit Elixir (Phoenix LiveView) und TailwindCSS (DaisyUI)

  • Wissen über Barrierefreiheit

Benefits

  • Du entscheidest dich zwischen 75% oder Vollzeit

  • Eine innovative Software mit echtem Mehrwert für unsere Kunden

  • Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit der Entwicklung und den Gründern, tägliche Releases

  • Ein professionelles, herzliches und motiviertes Team

  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten und auf Wunsch ortsunabhängiges Arbeiten

  • Viel Raum für Eigeninitiative und Mitgestaltung

  • Regelmäßige Team-Offsites

  • Unsere Werte: Gemeinschaft, Lernen, Verbesserung

  • Jahresgehalt zwischen 50.000 - 60.000 Euro in Vollzeit, abhängig von deiner Erfahrung

  • Auf Wunsch Zuschüsse für ein Fitnessabo und ein Deutschlandticket.

Bewerbungsunterlagen

  • Dein Lebenslauf

  • Ein Portfolio, das deinen Weg von Problem und Research zur implementierten Lösung zeigt

Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung!

title: (Junior) E-Commerce Kaufmann (w/m/d)
description:
Du denkst mit, setzt Dinge um und begeisterst dich für Shopify & AI? Gleichzeitig behältst du den Überblick, findest Lösungen und kommunizierst klar? Dann möchten wir dich kennenlernen!

Wir sind NETSHAKE – die AI-First E-Commerce-Agentur

Als Shopify Premier Partner und eine der führenden AI-First-Agenturen Europas vereinen wir fundiertes E-Commerce-Know-how mit künstlicher Intelligenz. Unser Ziel: bessere Ergebnisse, kürzere Umsetzungszeiten und maximaler Output.

Deine Rolle: Shopify & AI Traffic

Als (Junior) E-Commerce Kaufmann bringst du Shopify und AI Traffic zusammen. Du entwickelst Shops weiter, setzt Optimierungen um und arbeitest daran, dass sie bei Google, ChatGPT, Perplexity und Gemini gefunden und empfohlen werden.

Für deine Kunden bist du die zentrale Ansprechperson: Du leitest Workshops, legst gemeinsam mit ihnen Ziele fest und steuerst die Umsetzung deiner Projekte eigenverantwortlich. Dein Teamlead setzt den Rahmen – du sorgst dafür, dass aus Zielen Ergebnisse werden.

Unsere DNA: AI First

AI ist bei NETSHAKE keine Ergänzung, sondern die Grundlage unserer Arbeitsweise. Wir hinterfragen bestehende Abläufe, automatisieren gezielt und fördern den Ausbau deiner AI-Kompetenz. Unsere Überzeugung: Wer AI souverän einsetzt, macht sich nicht überflüssig, sondern unverzichtbar.

Du möchtest Verantwortung tragen, dich schnell weiterentwickeln und den E-Commerce von morgen mitgestalten? Dann werde Teil von NETSHAKE!

Aufgaben

🛍️ Shopify-Umsetzung

  • Du realisierst Shopify-Shops von der ersten Konzeption bis zum Go-live. Theme-Architektur, Liquid, App-Integrationen und Shopify Functions setzt du selbstständig um.

  • Du unterstützt Händler bei Fragen zu Shop-Struktur, Funktionen und technischen Entscheidungen – verständlich, transparent und mit Blick auf die passende Lösung.

  • Du übernimmst Verantwortung für den Erfolg des gesamten Projekts, nicht nur für einzelne Aufgaben.

🔎 GEO & KI-Sichtbarkeit

  • Du bringst GEO-Strategien in die Umsetzung: Mit strukturierten Daten, Schema Markup, Feeds und optimierten Inhalten schaffst du die Voraussetzungen dafür, dass Kundenshops in ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini & Co. als relevante Quellen erkannt und empfohlen werden.

  • Du analysierst Shops mit Blick auf ihre KI-Sichtbarkeit und entwickelst daraus konkrete Maßnahmen.

  • Du überprüfst Ergebnisse, testest neue Ansätze und optimierst kontinuierlich – auf Basis von Daten statt Bauchgefühl.

✍️ Content & Lifecycle

  • Du entwickelst Inhalte, die sowohl für klassische Suchmaschinen als auch für generative KI-Systeme optimiert sind.

  • Du betreust den gesamten Content-Lifecycle deiner Kundenprojekte: von der Erstellung über die Weiterentwicklung bis zum Monitoring.

  • Du erstellst monatliche Performance-Reportings und leitest daraus klare nächste Schritte ab.

⚙️ AI-Tools & Automation

  • Du integrierst AI konsequent in deinen Arbeitsalltag – von Recherche und Shop-Umsetzung über Content und Datenanalyse bis zu Qualitätssicherung und Reporting.

  • Du entwickelst AI-gestützte Workflows und Automatisierungen, die wiederkehrende Aufgaben reduzieren und den Output steigern.

  • Du probierst eigenständig neue AI-Technologien aus und bringst konkrete Einsatzmöglichkeiten ins Team ein.

🤝 Händler & Workshops

  • Du planst und leitest Händler-Workshops mit einem klaren Fokus auf messbare Projektergebnisse.

  • Du hältst Kunden und Team proaktiv auf dem Laufenden, sodass der aktuelle Projektstand jederzeit klar ist.

  • Nach jedem Projektabschluss holst du zwei Bewertungen ein – eine auf Shopify und eine auf Google. Dein Qualitätsanspruch: fünf Sterne.

Qualifikation

🎯 Ownership

Du übernimmst Verantwortung – für deine Aufgaben, das gesamte Projektergebnis und den gemeinsamen Teamerfolg. Wenn etwas nicht nach Plan läuft, konzentrierst du dich auf Lösungen statt auf Schuldzuweisungen.

⚡ Eigenverantwortung

Du erhältst ein Ziel und organisierst selbstständig den Weg dorthin. Du planst deine Sprints, behältst Fristen im Blick und kommunizierst Risiken rechtzeitig. Du wartest nicht darauf, angeschoben zu werden, sondern treibst deine Projekte selbst voran.

💡 Weitblick

Du denkst über einzelne Aufgaben hinaus, erkennst mögliche Probleme früh und entdeckst Verbesserungspotenzial in Abläufen. Statt nur Fragen aufzuwerfen, bringst du durchdachte Optionen und eine begründete Empfehlung mit. Bestehende Prozesse hinterfragst du konstruktiv – und entwickelst bessere Alternativen.

🤖 AI-Kompetenz

AI ist für dich mehr als ein hilfreiches Werkzeug: Sie prägt deine Herangehensweise. Du kennst ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity und Cursor und kannst einschätzen, welches Tool für welche Aufgabe den größten Nutzen bietet. Neue Tools und Claude Skills entdeckst und testest du eigenständig und zeigst dem Team, wie sie sich direkt sinnvoll einsetzen lassen. Du verknüpfst Tools, APIs und KI zu neuen Lösungen.

Außerdem bringst du einen hohen Qualitätsanspruch mit: Du gibst dich nicht damit zufrieden, dass etwas lediglich funktioniert, sondern möchtest wirklich gute Ergebnisse erzielen. Du nimmst Feedback offen an, lernst schnell und probierst Neues aus. Auf deine Zusagen ist Verlass – und wenn etwas dazwischenkommt, kommunizierst du das frühzeitig.

Must-haves

  • 🛍️ Shopify-Expertise: Du hast nachweislich Shopify-Shops für echte Händler aufgebaut und betreut. Mit Themes, Liquid und App-Integrationen arbeitest du sicher.

  • 📈 Content & Marketing: Du bringst Erfahrung in Content-Strategie, SEO oder digitalem Marketing mit – idealerweise mit messbaren Erfolgen.

  • 🔎 AI Search & GEO: Du kennst dich sehr gut mit ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini und Claude aus und verstehst, wie E-Commerce-Marken in KI-Such- und Antwortsystemen sichtbar werden.

  • ⚙️ AI Automation: Du hast bereits mit n8n, Make, Zapier, Custom GPTs oder vergleichbaren Lösungen gearbeitet.

  • 💻 Technisches Verständnis: Du verfügst über Grundkenntnisse in HTML, CSS, JavaScript, strukturierten Daten und Feeds.

  • 🎤 Kundenkommunikation: Du hast Erfahrung darin, Kundenworkshops durchzuführen und zu moderieren.

  • 🇩🇪 Deutsch auf C2-Niveau: Du drückst dich schriftlich wie mündlich klar, sicher und einwandfrei aus.

  • 🚀 Hands-on-Mentalität: Du möchtest nicht nur Konzepte entwickeln, sondern selbst umsetzen, Verantwortung übernehmen und Ergebnisse erzielen.

Benefits – warum NETSHAKE?

🤖 AI First – Wissen, das dich weiterbringt

Du arbeitest mit Premium-AI-Tools und vertiefst dein Wissen in regelmäßigen Trainings und Deep-Dives zu aktuellen Modellen, GEO-Techniken und AI-Workflows. Dabei geht es immer um die praktische Anwendung: mehr Output in weniger Zeit.

🚀 Entwicklung nach Leistung statt Betriebszugehörigkeit

Vom Rookie über den Expert bis zum Senior Expert: Wie schnell du dich entwickelst, hängt von deinen Fähigkeiten, deinen Ergebnissen und deinem Beitrag zur Teamkultur ab – nicht von festgelegten Wartezeiten.

💸 Performance-Bonus ohne Obergrenze

Dich erwartet ein attraktives Grundgehalt mit einem ungedeckelten Bonus. Grundlage ist unser NETSHAKE Performance Framework, mit dem wir deine Leistung quartalsweise in den Bereichen Output, Skills & Culture bewerten. Wer kontinuierlich überzeugt, kann entsprechend wachsen.

🎯 Verantwortung von Anfang an

Du betreust eigene Händler, steuerst eigene Projekte und triffst echte Entscheidungen. Dafür bekommst du Gestaltungsspielraum, kurze Abstimmungswege und direktes Feedback – innerhalb von Stunden statt Wochen.

📚 Lernen aus 26 Jahren E-Commerce-Erfahrung

Mehr als 1.600 Projekte und Einblicke in unterschiedlichste Wachstumsphasen bilden die Basis unseres Wissens. Du lernst von erfahrenen Profis, erhältst intensive Schulungen zu Shopify, E-Commerce und AI und entwickelst dich fachlich wie persönlich weiter.

🤝 Gemeinsam besser werden

Deine Ideen sind willkommen. Wir unterstützen Eigeninitiative, testen neue Ansätze, teilen unser Wissen und helfen einander weiter. Bei uns arbeitest du nicht einfach Aufgaben ab, sondern gestaltest NETSHAKE aktiv mit.

🌍 Remote arbeiten oder ins Office nach Dubai

Du kannst remote arbeiten oder unser modernes Büro im Herzen von Business Bay nutzen. Du entscheidest, an welchem Ort du am produktivsten bist.

Bereit für deinen nächsten Schritt?

Du willst wachsen? Wir auch. Bei NETSHAKE kombinierst du E-Commerce-Know-how mit AI-Kompetenz, übernimmst Verantwortung und arbeitest aktiv an der Zukunft unserer Branche mit.

Wichtig ist uns dabei: Diese Rolle passt zu Menschen, die sich einbringen und etwas bewegen möchten. Wir suchen Eigenverantwortung, Engagement, Begeisterung für AI und den Antrieb, sich in einem leistungsstarken, zukunftsorientierten Umfeld weiterzuentwickeln.

Du erkennst dich darin wieder? Dann bewirb dich jetzt bei NETSHAKE – wir freuen uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen! 🚀

title: Talent Coordinator
description:
Who are we?

Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company. We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems.

We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that.

We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft.

We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us!

About the Role:

Cohere seeks a high-performing Talent Coordinator, eager to take on a new challenge here in our Talent Operations team at Cohere. You will schedule a high volume of roles as a member of a small but mighty coordination team, who partner closely with key stakeholders to ensure interviews are arranged in a timely manner and that candidates have an excellent experience interviewing at Cohere. If you consider yourself highly organised, collaborative and someone who goes above and beyond to ensure excellence, we’d love to hear from you.

In this role you will be a liaison between teams supporting hiring managers, the Talent Team, the People team, and many more. Our Talent Coordinators are a primary internal and external point of contact and are a core part of our TA function supporting the scaling of Cohere. The team is not a behind the scenes support function, they are the beating heart of the Cohere Talent team.

You will schedule a high volume of interviews diligently and efficiently, manage a world class candidate experience, build strong and strategic relationships, manage multiple calendars and own the interview process with seamless communication and ownership from start to finish.

Our ATS is Ashby and we utilise the Advanced Scheduling functionality!

Candidates must be based in Germany to be considered for this opportunity.

As a Talent Coordinator, you will:

  • Schedule a large volume of interviews, ensuring our hiring teams and candidates are supported via seamless communication

  • Manage the candidate experience and build strong relationships across the organisation

  • Partner closely with a team of Executive Assistants, Hiring Managers and Recruiters

  • Support and optimize our interview processes & increase efficiency/automate where possible

  • Provide status updates, answer questions, and ensure timely follow up for our recruiters and candidate

  • Support on TA Operations projects where required

  • Keep our internal documentation up to date, working with detail and organization to ensure scalability and operational efficiency

This career opportunity may be a good match for you if you have:

  • 2+ years of professional work experience supporting a fast paced recruitment team

  • Experience scheduling a high volume of interviews, managing multiple calendars, and supporting a large volume of interviews with hiring managers and executive teams

  • Attention to detail coupled with the ability manage a high workload at a demanding pace

  • A team player "can-do" attitude and a proven track record of partnering with all functions and levels across an enterprise

  • Possess very strong time management & communication skills

  • Track record of executing on tasks for high-touch recruitment initiatives thoughtfully and efficiently at a fast pace

  • Ability to handle confidential and sensitive information with tact and discretion

  • Have a genuine passion for providing excellent candidate experiences

Full-Time Employees at Cohere enjoy these Perks:

  • A weekly lunch stipend of $75/£75 or equivalent in your local currency for lunch.

  • Full health and dental benefits, including a separate budget for mental health.

  • RRSP matching, 401K, Pension Scheme.

  • 100% Parental Leave top-up for up to 6 months, for either parent.

  • Annual enrichment benefits:

    Arts & culture, fitness/wellness, quality time, and a workspace improvement credit.

    Education & learning stipend for conferences, courses, and coaching.

  • 6 weeks of paid vacation (30 working days!)

  • Budget for traveling to other offices if you are remote, plus an annual company offsite.

How and Where We Work:

  • Cohere is remote-friendly, but we also have offices in Toronto, London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul with more opening soon.

  • For those in the office: a daily lunch program, plenty of snacks, and regular community and social events.

  • For those not near an office: a co-working benefit so you can work alongside others in your city.

  • Everyone receives a $500 home office stipend to set up your workspace properly.

If any of the above doesn’t line up exactly with your experience, we still encourage you to apply.


We strive to create an inclusive work environment for all; we welcome applicants from all backgrounds and are committed to providing equal opportunities. Should you require any accommodations during the recruitment process, please submit an Accommodations Request Form, and we will work together to meet your needs.

We may use AI-enabled tools to screen and assess applicants against the criteria for this position. This helps our recruiters identify potentially qualified candidates, but it doesn't limit the applications our recruiters may review or consider.

Beware of Scams: Cohere will never ask for payment or third-party services (e.g., CV writing) as part of our hiring process. All legitimate roles are listed on the Cohere careers page and LinkedIn only, with all communications from Cohere employees coming from an ----- or ----- email alias. If jobs are viewed on other sites then please verify these through our official careers page.

title: Full-Stack Engineer - ElevenMusic
description:
About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

ElevenMusic is a consumer music app where music is the core product: a place to listen, create, remix and stream. The team works in its own environment, separate from the main org, and is agent-first with fast CI, so ideas reach users within a day or two.

You’ll own features end to end, from spotting the problem to shipping the product and the backend behind it. Most of what you build is new, in a space where few companies are working with AI and music, so there’s no playbook. You’ll define the problem yourself, test ideas with real users, and work alongside research engineering to turn model capabilities into things people love using. What you ship goes live to a large audience within days.

You’re a builder with strong product taste who understands every layer of the system. You use AI to move fast, but you own and understand everything you ship. You care about music and the people who make it.

Requirements

  • Have shipped and owned a well-designed consumer product from zero to real users, across frontend and backend

  • Understand your systems deeply enough to spot immediately when a PR is wrong, insecure or needlessly complex

  • Show excellent product judgement: you know the most valuable thing to build, and what not to build

  • Work autonomously with minimal direction, and take responsibility for fixing problems as you find them

  • Have a real interest in music, or in the people who make it

Bonus: Open-source or GitHub track record, experience building music or audio products, or experience with recommendation systems or embeddings.

Location

This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere in Europe and the US East Coast, with the ability to operate in GMT-5 to GMT+1 timezones required. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in London, New York, Dublin, Amsterdam, and Warsaw.

  • Eine Aufgabe mit Sinn: Du hilfst Menschen, die gerade gestresst sind.

title: Freelance, Recovery Operations
description:
Who We Are

Zefir is building an AI autopilot for home sales in Europe, starting in France: an AI agent runs the entire sale and purchase journey end-to-end, orchestrating local brokers, portals, buyers, and documents.

Backed by €60 million from top-tier investors Sequoia Capital and Kima Ventures, we're committed to accelerating life changes for millions of current and future European homeowners.

Mission freelance de 7 mois, du 1er février au 25 août 2027, à Paris 9e.

🎯 La mission

Quand un vendeur ou un agent partenaire vend un bien hors du cadre contractuel de son mandat Zefir, la squad Protect le détecte, le prouve, puis transforme ce manquement en cash encaissé, avec l'équipe Sales Zefir et nos avocats partenaires. Tu leads cette squad.

La squad est jeune et en pleine construction : elle est passée de 0 € à plus de 100 000 € de chiffre d'affaires en 3 mois, et l'objectif est d'atteindre 500 000 € par mois d'ici la fin du S1 2027. Les premiers outils et process tournent déjà, mais l'essentiel reste à bâtir, et c'est toi qui t'en charges.

🛠️ Ce que tu feras

Ton rôle s'articule autour de quatre axes :

1. Lead la squad Protect

  • Pilotage : suivre la performance de toute la chaîne, de la détection des fraudes au cash encaissé, côté Sales comme côté avocats. Repérer ce qui décroche et porter les plans d'action.

  • Weekly : préparer et animer le weekly d'équipe : chiffres de la semaine, points bloquants, décisions à prendre.

  • OKR : définir chaque trimestre les objectifs et les résultats clés de la squad.

2. Générer du pipe de recouvrement

  • Run : chaque jour, revoir les ventes détectées par nos outils et décider s'il faut demander les documents officiels, comme l'acte de vente. Puis revoir les actes reçus et, à partir de l'analyse produite par nos outils, décider d'enclencher ou non le recouvrement par nos équipes.

  • Build : automatiser chaque étape qui peut l'être, pour que le funnel opère en totale autonomie (ex : automatiser le traitement des réponses du service de publicité foncière reçues par email).

  • Pilotage : t'assurer que le funnel tourne et qu'aucun dossier ne reste bloqué à une étape. Quand ça bloque, tu investigues, tu trouves la cause et tu la corriges.

3. Convertir le pipe avec l'équipe Sales Zefir

  • Build : donner à l'équipe Sales des dossiers prêts à travailler : analyse juridique, brief d'appel, mises en demeure, suivi des échéanciers. Automatiser des tâches qu'ils font aujourd'hui manuellement pour augmenter leur productivité (ex : automatiser la rédaction et l'envoi des mises en demeure).

  • Pilotage : suivre chaque semaine avec l'équipe la conversion des dossiers en protocoles signés et le cash encaissé. Repérer les indicateurs qui décrochent et proposer un plan d'action.

4. Convertir le pipe avec nos avocats

  • Run : être l'interlocuteur de nos deux cabinets. Chaque semaine, tu tiens un point avec chacun pour revoir le pipe dossier par dossier. Entre deux points, tu fournis les pièces demandées et tu rends les arbitrages de Zefir : plancher de négociation, assignation, classement, etc. Tu comprends aussi leurs enjeux, leurs irritants et ce qui les bloque, pour améliorer nos process avec eux.

  • Build : faire évoluer l'outil de suivi partagé avec les cabinets (ex : relances automatiques, to-do priorisée, etc.).

  • Pilotage : suivre les délais, la conversion et les coûts de chaque cabinet, et les challenger chaque semaine. Comme pour la partie Sales, tu repères les indicateurs qui décrochent et tu proposes un plan d'action.

Partout, tu construis vite, en MVP, avec Claude Code, Lovable, Pipedream et BigQuery.

🙋 Profil recherché

On cherche un profil Ops builder : quelqu'un qui aime partir d'une page blanche, mettre les mains dans le cambouis, puis construire les process et les automatiser.

  • Une expérience dans un rôle Ops où tu as construit toi-même un process ou un outil de zéro, idéalement en start-up.

  • Le goût du terrain : tu traites toi-même les premiers dossiers pour comprendre le problème avant de l'automatiser.

  • Une vraie autonomie dans l'ambiguïté : peu de cadre, des priorités qui bougent, et c'est toi qui poses la structure.

  • Une rigueur à toute épreuve et une organisation solide, pour mener plusieurs chantiers de front sans en lâcher aucun.

  • Le goût de la performance : on se fixe des objectifs ambitieux, et tu fais tout pour les atteindre.

💰 Modalités

  • Démarrage : 1er février 2027.

  • Durée : 7 mois, du 1er février au 25 août 2027.

  • Lieu : Paris 9e, bureaux du Peletier.

  • Rémunération : TJM à 450 € HT.

  • Processus : un échange avec Constance, qui occupe le poste aujourd'hui, puis avec Arthus de Torquat, Lead Operations.


Benefits

The following is for permanent employees only. For other contracts (interns, apprentices, fixed-term..), please, check with your recruiter.

  • Competitive salary: You can run your own simulation with our salary calculator.

  • BSPCE (Stock Options): Available for everyone, with monthly vesting after year one, over a 4-year period.

  • Healthcare plan: Full coverage with Alan for team members, their partners, and children.

  • Office in Le Peletier, Paris (9th arrondissement): With flexible remote work options.

  • Swile meal card: €11 per worked day.

  • Swile mobility card: €45/month to support sustainable transportation (metro, carpooling, biking…).

  • Team events: Monthly Mixers to connect and share good times, and quarterly All Hands to celebrate wins across the company.

Our Operating Principles

🏔️ Steep Mountains Are Steep: Setting ambitious goals and working hard to achieve them.

🌊 Ride Reality: Actively seeking challenges and thriving by adapting flexibly to changes.

🏀 Play for the Front of the Jersey: Prioritizing team success over individual recognition.

Application & Process

We welcome applications from anyone, regardless of background, gender, sexual orientation, religion, age, or experience. Our team values authenticity and diverse perspectives.

For all roles, our interview process emphasizes hands-on exercises, case studies, or discussions about specific examples of your previous work. We ensure objectives and expectations are clearly communicated at every step.

Backed by €60 million from top-tier investors Sequoia Capital and Kima Ventures, we're committed to accelerating life changes for millions of current and future European homeowners.

The role

As a Business Development Representative (BDR), you are the first commercial point of contact with our prospects. You join Zefir's Sales team and reach out to homeowners who have run a valuation on our website but have not booked an appointment yet.

The core of the role is reactivation: these homeowners showed interest, then stopped there. You are the one who gets them moving again, on the phone, one by one.

Your goal as a BDR: create the sales opportunities that feed our revenue directly.

What you will do

  • Handle around 100 calls per day, with a target of 3 to 4 meetings booked daily.

  • Run qualification calls of about 20 minutes: understand the client's project, present Zefir's value proposition, and book a follow-up meeting with an Account Executive.

  • Keep rigorous track of your pipeline and move leads through the Sales funnel.

  • Work closely with Account Executives to maximize conversion and contribute directly to Zefir's growth.

Career path

We are transparent on this. A BDR role can open the door to an Account Executive role internally, but there is no automatic progression and no guaranteed timeline. Any move depends on three things: performance, behavioral fit, and team needs.

What we can commit to: our Consumer Account Executives, the role a BDR grows into, and our Sales Managers are filled exclusively through internal mobility. We never open these roles externally. Top performers are rewarded, with uncapped variable pay and real visibility.

Who we are looking for

  • 0 to 2 years of experience. This role is designed for a junior profile who wants to learn sales on the phone, fast and in the fiel d.

  • Master's level graduate from a business school, an engineering school or a university, or a first experience as a BDR, SDR or sales rep in a structured environment.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication. Fluency in French is required. Fluent English is a plus, not a must-have.

  • Rigorous and well organized, able to sustain a high volume of client interactions over time.

  • Energized by performance and intensity, with a client and results orientation.

  • Resilient, and able to take feedback to improve quickly.

One honest note: this role is intense and repetitive by design. Around a hundred calls a day, every day, with rejection along the way. That is what makes you improve fast at sales, and it is not for everyone.

Compensation and working setup

  • €47K package: €35K base plus €12K of uncapped variable, on top of the BSPCE granted to everyone.

  • Three days on-site, two days of remote work per week, at our Le Peletier office in the 9th arrondissement. Being in the room matters on this role, you learn to sell by hearing others sell.

title: Implementation Specialist
description:
WorkWave is a leading provider of SaaS solutions, helping businesses streamline their operations and drive growth through innovative technology. As we continue to expand, we are looking for an experienced Implementation Specialist to join our Global Professional Services team. In this role, you will play a key part in supporting our ongoing SaaS client implementations and software integrations—working alongside our senior product leads and implementation team to drive project delivery, manage data migration and mapping tasks, coordinate User Acceptance Testing (UAT), and provide project management support across active client go-lives.

Operating as a critical member of our APAC delivery team, you will serve as the engine powering project execution. While our core product leads oversee deep system configuration, you will ensure data flows accurately between systems, test integration workflows, keep stakeholders aligned, and deliver a smooth, high-trust customer onboarding experience.

This role demands an exceptional blend of analytical accuracy, clear communication, and calm composure under competing priorities. You will bring structure and momentum to active implementations, ensuring every client transitions smoothly into live operation. This role is based in Melbourne, Australia, reporting to the Head of Professional Services.

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Technical Consultancy & Implementation: Deliver high-quality technical consultancy and implementation services in line with the contract and Statement of Work (SOW), ensuring a consistently positive customer experience.

  • Data Migration & Integration Validation: Manage data preparation, mapping, and migration activities while executing UAT and test scenarios to confirm solutions and integrations perform accurately prior to go-live.

  • Implementation & Configuration Support: Partner with senior implementation leads to execute project tasks, software configuration, and system validation across active client deployments.

  • Project Governance & Risk Tracking: Track implementation progress alongside project leads, complete stage-gate task lists within agreed SLAs, and proactively highlight risks or issues that could impact delivery timelines.

  • Customer Enablement & Adoption: Communicate clearly with clients regarding project requirements, delivering hands-on training and guiding them through business process improvements and technology adoption.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with Sales and Customer Success colleagues to ensure seamless project handovers, smooth onboarding, and timely escalation of commercial expansion opportunities.

  • Product Mastery & Standards: Maintain strong working knowledge of WorkWave products, delivery methodologies, and company policies, representing WorkWave professionally at all times.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:

  • Implementation Experience: 2+ years of experience conducting software implementations within a SaaS environment, with a strong grasp of data migration, mapping, and UAT workflows.

  • Client Training & Enablement: Proven ability to train clients on new software platforms and updated operational processes.

  • Domain & System Familiarity: Experience with Finance, Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP), and/or Payroll systems is advantageous, as is familiarity with the Cleaning, Facilities Management, or Security industries.

  • Stakeholder & Priority Management: Demonstrated ability to manage stakeholder expectations and conflicting priorities while maintaining perspective, accuracy, and composure.

  • Situational & Commercial Awareness: Strong judgment to escalate delivery risks appropriately to management and spot additional commercial opportunities during client engagements.

  • Communication & Professionalism: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills with a commitment to high standards of professional conduct and teamwork.

  • Education: A Bachelor’s degree in IT or a business-related field is desirable (no specific licences or certifications required).

Compensation

Additional Information

WHAT YOU SHOULD KNOW ABOUT US:

  • Laid back, but high-performing: We offer a casual work environment, remote flexibility, and a commitment to building innovative, best-in-class solutions that drive customer success.

  • Customer-focused: We deliver software and services that make a measurable difference to our clients and their businesses.

  • Inclusive and collaborative: We build partnerships based on mutual trust, shared goals, and open communication.

  • Curious and driven: Our team values proactive problem-solvers who want to make an impact while enjoying what they do.

LOVE WHAT YOU DO, NO MATTER WHERE YOU DO IT:

  • Remote-First Global Community: WorkWave connects talent worldwide with a modern remote-first culture. You get the stability and reach of an established global platform combined with the autonomy, innovation, and direct impact of a scale-up.

A GLOBAL COMPANY WITH A LOCAL PRESENCE:

  • True Workplace Flexibility: We support modern work/life balance. Whether collaborating virtually or meeting up face-to-face, our teams are fully equipped to deliver high-impact results remotely across Australia.

  • Global Footprint: Headquartered at the Bell Works campus in New Jersey (USA), we have team members across North America, Europe, and the Asia-Pacific region.

  • Connected Culture: Regardless of location, every team member joins an inclusive network committed to supporting each other, delivering great software, and engaging with our local communities.

REWARD & WELLBEING:

In addition to statutory superannuation (guaranteed at the current legislated rate) and standard National Employment Standards (NES) leave—such as 4 weeks of annual leave and 10 days of personal/carer’s leave—we provide:

  • 5 additional days of Flexible Wellness Leave per year

  • Enhanced Parental Leave scheme

  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for confidential mental health, wellbeing, and lifestyle support

  • Paid Community Volunteer Days

  • Global & Local Perk Schemes: Personal travel discounts and employee shopping discount programs

DIVERSITY, EQUITY & INCLUSION

WorkWave is an equal opportunity employer committed to creating a safe, inclusive, and diverse work environment. We adhere to the Australian Fair Work Act 2009, the Sex Discrimination Act, the Disability Discrimination Act, and Victoria’s Equal Opportunity Act 2010.

All employment decisions are based on merit, competence, and business needs, without regard to age, race, cultural or ethnic background, religion or belief, gender identity, sex, sexual orientation, disability status, marital or parental status, or any other protected attribute under Commonwealth and Victorian law.

Studies show that candidates from underrepresented backgrounds—including women, First Nations people, and neurodivergent individuals—often hesitate to apply unless they meet 100% of the criteria. If you are excited about this role and feel your transferable skills could add value, we strongly encourage you to submit your application.

If you require reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, please inform our Talent Acquisition team.

WORK RIGHTS & REMUNERATION TRANSPARENCY

  • Work Rights: Applicants must hold current, unrestricted working rights for Australia (Australian Citizenship, Permanent Residency, or a valid work visa with no work-hour limitations). Proof of working rights (e.g., VEVO check or passport) may be requested during the recruitment process.

  • Salary Estimates: Automated salary estimates generated by third-party job boards (such as SEEK, LinkedIn, or Glassdoor) are not set by WorkWave and may not reflect the actual package for this role. Competitive packages are discussed transparently with candidates based on experience and market benchmarks.

PRIVACY & APPLICANT DATA

By submitting your application, you consent to WorkWave collecting, holding, and using your personal information for recruitment and talent acquisition purposes in accordance with the Australian Privacy Principles and our Privacy Policy . If your application is unsuccessful, we may retain your profile to contact you regarding future opportunities that match your background. You may request access to, correction of, or deletion of your personal details at any time. https://www.workwave.com/privacy-policy.

title: Enterprise Account Executive
description:
AssetWatch serves global manufacturers by powering manufacturing uptime through the delivery of an unparalleled condition monitoring experience, with a passion to care about the assets our customers care for every day. We are a devoted and capable team that includes world-renowned engineers and distinguished business leaders united by a common goal – To build the future of predictive maintenance. As we enter the next phase of rapid growth, we are seeking people to help lead the journey.

What’s the Opportunity

AssetWatch is seeking a high-performing Enterprise Account Executive to drive growth. This role is responsible for acquiring new logos and expanding existing relationships by delivering AssetWatch’s predictive maintenance solutions to asset-intensive industrial customers.

The ideal candidate thrives in complex, multi-stakeholder sales environments and is skilled at engaging both plant-level operators and executive leadership. This role requires a strong understanding of industrial operations, reliability, and value-based selling.

This role is located in the United States.

Account Ownership & Growth

  • Own and develop a defined set of named enterprise accounts within target industries (e.g., food & beverage, packaging, metals, chemicals)
  • Build and execute strategic account plans to drive new logo acquisition and multi-site expansion
  • Identify and prioritize high-value opportunities across plants, regions, and business units

Revenue Generation

  • Consistently meet or exceed quarterly and annual revenue targets
  • Build and manage a high-quality pipeline with strong conversion rates
  • Drive deals from initial discovery through pilot, proof of value, and enterprise rollout

Customer Engagement

  • Engage plant-level stakeholders including maintenance managers, reliability engineers, and plant managers
  • Build relationships with executive buyers (VP Operations, VP Manufacturing, Reliability Leaders)
  • Lead consultative discovery focused on operational challenges, downtime, and ROI

Solution Selling

  • Position AssetWatch’s full platform including vibration, temperature, oil, and emerging solutions
  • Articulate clear business value tied to reduced downtime, improved reliability, and cost savings
  • Develop and present compelling ROI-driven business cases

Deal Execution

  • Navigate complex sales cycles involving multiple stakeholders and approval processes
  • Lead pilot programs and ensure successful transition to paid deployments
  • Negotiate commercial terms and close enterprise agreements

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner with Customer Success to drive adoption and expansion
  • Provide market feedback to Product and Marketing teams
  • Collaborate with leadership on territory strategy and forecasting

Forecasting & Discipline

  • Maintain accurate pipeline and forecast visibility
  • Adhere to defined sales processes and stage exit criteria
  • Participate in regular deal reviews and account planning sessions

Qualifications

  • 10+ years of experience in B2B sales in a complex or technical environment
  • 5+ years of experience selling directly to plant-level personas (e.g., maintenance, reliability, operations)
  • Proven track record of consistently exceeding quota in enterprise or strategic account sales
  • Experience managing multi-stakeholder, long-cycle sales processes
  • Strong business acumen with the ability to quantify and communicate ROI
  • Experience selling into industrial, manufacturing, or asset-intensive environments preferred
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and negotiation skills

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience selling predictive maintenance, IIoT, SaaS, or industrial technology solutions
  • Familiarity with reliability programs, maintenance workflows, and plant operations
  • Experience with land-and-expand sales models
  • Ability to navigate both plant-level and corporate decision-making structures

#LI-REMOTE

The base salary range for this full-time position is posted below, plus equity and benefits. Variable pay, bonuses, and other cash compensation will be discussed throughout the interview process.

The salary range was determined by role, level, and location. Individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range applicable to your location during the hiring process.

AssetWatch Salary Range (US)

$120,000—$135,000 USD

What We Offer:
AssetWatch is a remote-first company that puts people at the center of everything we do. We want our team members to thrive - that’s why we offer a range of benefits and perks designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance.

  • Competitive compensation package including stock options
  • Flexible work schedule
  • Comprehensive benefits including retirement plan match
  • Opportunity to make a real impact every day
  • Work with a dynamic and growing team
  • Unlimited PTO

We have a distributed team that works remotely across locations in the United States and Ontario, Canada. Collaboration within core working hours is required.

title: GTM Strategist
description:
About this Role

As a GTM Strategist, you own the pre-sale story for Category Partnerships and turn Fandom’s capabilities into clear, compelling category-specific decks that help sellers open doors and create opportunities. Fandom’s Category Partnerships business supports advertisers across CPG, QSR, Financial Services, Retail, Technology, Telecommunications and Automotive.

You’ll translate Fandom’s audience, insights, products and capabilities into clear, compelling category narratives and polished sales decks that show brands why Fandom matters to their business.

This role supports sales and sits at the intersection of strategy, storytelling and sales enablement—identifying the strongest story for each category and giving our Revenue teams the materials they need to proactively create opportunities.

You Will...

Own Category Partnership Storytelling

  • Develop and maintain pre-sale decks, narratives and sales materials for priority advertiser categories including CPG, QSR, Financial Services, Automotive, Retail, Telco and Technology.

  • Translate Fandom’s fan intelligence, audience insights and capabilities into simple, persuasive stories tied to category and advertiser objectives.

  • Customize core Category Partnership narratives for priority accounts and opportunities.

  • Ensure every deck has a clear strategic story, strong narrative flow and polished presentation.

  • Keep Category Partnership materials current as Fandom’s insights, products and marketplace positioning evolve.

Develop Proactive Category Narratives

  • Understand the key business challenges, consumer behaviors and marketing priorities within each category.

  • Identify the fan behaviors, cultural moments and audience opportunities most relevant to each vertical (i.e. fan holidays, seasonal moments, major releases)

  • Develop proactive stories that give sellers a reason to approach clients before a brief or RFP arrives.

  • Connect Fandom’s capabilities into cohesive recommendations rather than presenting individual products in isolation.

  • Identify opportunities to create repeatable category narratives and sales materials that can scale across multiple accounts.

Partner With Revenue

  • Work closely with Category Partnership sellers to understand account priorities and translate them into compelling pre-sale stories.

  • Support priority client meetings, proactive outreach and category-specific pitches with strategic narratives and presentation materials.

  • Incorporate seller and client feedback to continuously strengthen Category Partnership positioning and collateral.

  • Partner across Insights, Product Marketing, Creative and other teams to bring the strongest Fandom story into each category narrative.

What Success Looks Like

  • Revenue teams have clear, differentiated and compelling stories for every priority category.

  • Sellers can confidently explain why Fandom matters to a CPG, QSR, Financial Services, Retail, Tech, Telco or Automotive marketer—and translate that story into a reason for a client conversation.

  • Ultimately, this role helps shift Category Partnerships from responding to briefs to proactively creating opportunities, using strong strategy and storytelling to drive client interest, pipeline and revenue.

You Have...

  • Experience servicing media sales teams at a publisher
  • 5+ years of experience in pre-sale advertising solutions, deck-building, storytelling, sales enablement
  • Deep understanding of one or more key advertiser categories including CPG, QSR, Retail, Financial Services, Tech, Telco, or Auto.
  • Experience building scalable commercial solutions and translating custom concepts into repeatable offerings.
  • Excellent communication, storytelling, and enablement skills.
  • Highly collaborative mindset with the ability to influence stakeholders across Revenue, Product, Marketing, Operations, and AI teams.
  • Demonstrated capability using generative AI tools (e.g., Gemini, NotebookLM) to enhance productivity, paired with the ability to critically audit and verify outputs for accuracy, security, and context.

Bonus Points…

  • You understand the art of deck building and are comfortable designing/editing a deck beyond just storytelling
  • You leverage AI technologies but you don't rely on them for deck design or copy

Benefits & Perks

  • Salary Range = $83k - $152k - (Actual salary available will vary based on location and market factors.)
  • Vibrant team culture
  • Comprehensive Medical, Dental, Vision
  • Training (unlimited Udemy + more)
  • Flexible working hours and time off
  • Equity & Retirement Programs including 401K match
  • Paid Parental Leave
  • International work environment with start-up culture

About Fandom

Fandom is the world’s largest fan platform where fans immerse themselves in imagined worlds across entertainment and gaming. Reaching more than 350 million unique visitors per month and hosting more than 250,000 wikis, Fandom is the #1 source for in-depth information on pop culture, gaming, TV and film, where fans learn about and celebrate their favorite fandoms. Fandom’s Gaming division manages the online video game retailer Fanatical. Fandom Productions, the content arm of Fandom, enhances the fan experience through curated editorial coverage and branded content from trusted and established publishing brands Gamespot, TV Guide and Metacritic, along with its Emmy-nominated Honest Trailers and the weekly video news program The Loop. For more information follow @getfandom or visit: www.fandom.com.

Fandom is an equal opportunity employer. Fandom values diversity, and all employment decisions are made on the basis of job requirements and individual qualifications.

title: Bilingual Customer Experience Specialist (Spanish)
description:
We're transforming the grocery industry

At Instacart, we invite the world to share love through food because we believe everyone should have access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together. Where others see a simple need for grocery delivery, we see exciting complexity and endless opportunity to serve the varied needs of our community. We work to deliver an essential service that customers rely on to get their groceries and household goods, while also offering safe and flexible earnings opportunities to Instacart Personal Shoppers.

Instacart has become a lifeline for millions of people, and we’re building the team to help push our shopping cart forward. If you’re ready to do the best work of your life, come join our table.

Instacart is a Flex First team

There’s no one-size fits all approach to how we do our best work. Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work—whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop—while staying connected and building community through regular in-person events. Learn more about our flexible approach to where we work.

Overview

The Customer Experience (CX) team sits at the center of Instacart’s support ecosystem, serving our diverse community of consumers, shoppers, retailers, and advertisers through both direct support and scalable solutions. We partner closely with cross-functional teams across Product, Engineering, and Operations to surface insights from the front line, reduce friction in the customer journey, and shape future roadmaps.

We deliver empathetic, high-quality support through a blend of data-driven, operational excellence. By focusing on clear communication, critical thinking, and continuous improvement, we ensure that every customer interaction not only resolves the immediate issue but also consistently enhances the overall Instacart experience.

About the Job

  • This role plays a vital part in supporting our consumers, shoppers, retailers, and advertisers. We are currently hiring for a variety of shifts, including mid-day, and evening coverage, to ensure we provide seamless service throughout the day. Schedule flexibility—including availability for evenings, weekends, and holidays—is essential to meeting the diverse needs of our community.
  • Handle live customer contacts (phone, chat, and/or email) for up to 100% of your scheduled time, consistently delivering clear, empathetic, and efficient support.
  • Navigate and execute complex workflows using established tools, policies, and knowledge base content to resolve a wide range of order and account issues.
  • Resolve edge cases by carefully following documented procedures, seeking guidance when needed, and escalating to the appropriate teams when issues fall outside standard paths.
  • Conduct thorough investigations into customer issues—reviewing account history, order details, and prior interactions—to ensure accurate and fair outcomes.
  • Create internal transfer tickets and document cases with clear, detailed notes so downstream teams have the context they need to resolve issues efficiently.
  • Proactively identify patterns, pain points, and process gaps in day-to-day work, and provide concrete suggestions and recommendations to supervisors and pillar leadership.
  • Act as a positive team player and informal leader by modeling best practices, sharing tips and insights with peers, and contributing to a supportive, inclusive team environment.
  • Surface emerging issues and operational challenges (such as tooling bugs, policy ambiguities, or contact spikes) to leadership quickly and with clear examples, helping the team respond and adapt in real time.

About You

Minimum qualifications

  • High school diploma or equivalent (some college or specialized training a plus)
  • 1+ year in a customer-facing role (support, retail, hospitality, call center, etc.) with a track record of strong service
  • Fluency in Spanish, both spoken and written
  • Comfort handling live contacts for most of the day (phone, chat, and/or email) in a fast-paced, metrics-driven environment
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, including clear documentation of cases and transfers, attention to detail and ability to follow established workflows
  • Problem-solving mindset with the ability to investigate issues, interpret account/order details, and make sound judgments within policy
  • Emotional intelligence and resilience when dealing with upset or frustrated customers and complex situations
  • Basic technical proficiency (navigating multiple systems, CRM tools, browser-based applications, and common productivity tools like Google Workspace)
  • Schedule flexibility to support evenings, weekends, and holidays based on business needs
  • Comfort working with AI-assisted tools and willingness to adopt new technologies that enhance customer support workflows and drive efficiency

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience in a contact center or multi-channel support environment (phone + chat + email)
  • Prior exposure to complex, policy-heavy workflows (e.g., financial services, logistics, e‑commerce, or marketplaces)
  • Familiarity with CRM and contact center tools (Salesforce, Genesys/Ujet, Zendesk, etc.)
  • Demonstrated experience surfacing trends or issues to leadership and proposing improvements
  • Proven ability to work collaboratively on a team, share best practices, and provide peer support or informal mentorship

Work Schedule

  • Full-time | 40 hours per week
  • Operations run 7 days a week | 7:00 AM – 11:00 PM EST / 4:00 AM – 8:00 PM PST

Shift assignments are based on business needs. Flexibility to work evenings, weekends, and holidays is required.

#LI-Remote

Instacart provides highly market-competitive compensation and benefits in each location where our employees work. This role is remote and the base pay range for a successful candidate is dependent on their permanent work location. Please review our Flex First remote work policy here.

Offers may vary based on many factors, such as candidate experience and skills required for the role. Please read more about our benefits offerings here.

For US based candidates, the base pay ranges for a successful candidate are listed below.

CA, NY, CT, NJ

$20.67—$21.88 USD

WA

$19.71—$20.92 USD

OR, DE, ME, MA, MD, NH, RI, VT, DC, PA, VA, CO, TX, IL, HI

$19.23—$20.19 USD

All other states

$17.31—$18.27 USD

title: Admissions Advisor: Morocco
description:
About Global University Systems (GUS)

Global University Systems is an international education group that empowers students to transform their lives through education. We believe education drives careers, lives, and society forward, enabling a brighter future for all. Our network of 30 institutions offers the broadest range of industry-relevant skills through inclusive, accessible, and digital-first learning. We currently educate around 122,000 students on campuses worldwide and have 20M+ unique subscribers to our courses. Our global ecosystem powers accessible digital learning and academic achievement.

Position

We are seeking a meticulous and self-driven Admissions Advisor to take full ownership of the end-to-end admissions process for our French universities. Working remotely, you will manage a live caseload, ensuring every application is processed accurately and efficiently while consistently meeting established KPIs. This role requires complete accountability for each student file from application through to enrolment.

Key Result Areas

  • Manage a live portfolio of student applications, ensuring every case remains accurate, complete, and progresses efficiently through each stage of the admissions cycle.
  • Review, verify, and process application documentation in accordance with the admission requirements and quality standards of French universities.
  • Take full ownership of individual performance metrics by meeting application deadlines, proactively identifying risks, and ensuring timely resolution of outstanding issues.
  • Act as the primary point of contact for students, partner universities, and internal teams, ensuring clear communication and seamless coordination throughout the admissions process.
  • Maintain the highest standards of accuracy and compliance by ensuring all applications meet institutional requirements before submission.
  • Monitor personal performance, analyse workflow efficiency, and implement process improvements to enhance productivity, accuracy, and student experience.

Requirements

Essential Criteria

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent qualification.
  • Must have excellent verbal, written, and comprehension skills in both English and French.
  • Minimum of 2 years' experience in admissions management, student enrollment, or a similar administrative role within higher education or university admissions.
  • Proven experience managing high-volume application processing, documentation, and casework with exceptional accuracy and attention to detail.
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently in a remote environment, effectively managing priorities and delivering results with minimal supervision.
  • Self-motivated, disciplined, and capable of working independently in a remote, KPI-driven environment.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to manage multiple stakeholders professionally.

Desirable Criteria

  • Excellent organizational and time management skills, with a strong eye for detail.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with a continuous improvement mindset.
  • Proficiency in using CRM systems, admissions platforms, and Microsoft Office applications.
  • Highly accountable, taking full ownership of work and outcomes.
  • Calm, resilient, and able to perform effectively under pressure while managing competing deadlines.
  • Committed to delivering a high standard of service, accuracy, and compliance throughout the admissions process.

Location

The position is home-based with travel if required.

Other Information

Please note this position is only available on our consultancy agreement.

The post holder may be asked to undertake different or additional duties in line with business requirements at the request of their line manager.

There is an expectation that all employees will maintain the values of the Group and comply with the Code of Conduct, as well as equality and diversity, health and safety, and safeguarding policies.
