title: Copywriter - eCommerce Email Marketing Agency
description:
The main purpose of the Copywriter is to work on copy-related tasks for your assigned clients and stores as part of the Service Department, with the responsibility to create quality, effective, well-written, error-free, and impactful email marketing campaigns that convert and drive sales for our clients.

As our Copywriter, this will include writing the copy for a variety of clients’ marketing campaigns in a way that reflects their message, brand, and tone of voice, while also coming up with innovative and catchy copy ideas for clients’ marketing campaigns, and ensuring that your copywriting work is of the highest standard and delivered on time. This includes working on copy tasks such as email banners, SMS/MMS graphics, and a variety of marketing flows and campaigns.

Mission statement:

The primary mission of our Copywriter is to maintain the high copy standards of our company by playing an active role in the copy creation and editing process across our range of clients and for our internal marketing material.

About Us

Hustler Marketing is a world-class email marketing agency. We customize plans of attack for each of our clients to help them double or even triple their email revenue.

HM is made up of 100+ people from around the world. We work remotely, yet we’re most proud of our ability to crush it as a cohesive team. We’re team-minded, and strive to create a culture where each person is encouraged to do their best.

As for clients, our list is incredibly diverse, with stores ranging from 300K-20M/year in revenue in nearly every niche you can think of.

We know that becoming the best agency begins with having the best team members—which is why we might just be looking for you!

Responsibilities

  • Creating high-quality, on-brand copy for your assigned clients’ email campaigns and flows, as well as SMS/MMS campaigns and flows using various professional writing tools (including the Google Workspace Suite, Grammarly, and other writing tools), when and as directed by Account Managers
  • Creating and developing marketing-oriented and effective copy decks that are focused on conversions
  • Assisting with various copywriting tasks as part of the Copy Team

  • Continuously working to discover industry-wide best practices and standards and present your findings to the Copy Lead, the Head of Copy, and the Service Director
  • Being available to assist with all internal copy-related needs from other departments
  • Directly reporting to the Head of Copy and the Service Director (in that structural order)

Positions Specs:

  • Full-time commitment while meeting our general availability for office hours
  • An average of 140 tracked hours per month consistently
  • Fixed-rate monthly salary paid in USD
  • Receive contractor status after signing our non-disclosure agreement
  • Exclusivity agreement (nullifying the possibility to work in a position of a similar nature while working for Hustler Marketing)
  • Committing to a 30-day notice period after the first month
  • Regular performance reviews every 9-12 months, with the first one being after 3-6 months

Requirements

  • At least 12 months of experience working as a Copywriter in a professional role or similar experience in a copywriting role at another agency (Preference will be given to candidates who have worked with remote teams and team members from different countries or have agency experience)
  • Experience using Klaviyo or having any agency experience is considered a plus
  • Having an established copywriting portfolio showcasing elevated, effective, and on-brand copy written for a variety of clients, stores, and niches
  • Must possess the ability to create copy for a variety of clients, regardless of their brand and niche
  • Strong writing and communication skills to be able to create and deliver quality marketing content
  • Have the ability to take action and work fast to implement changes and solve copy-related problems
  • Must possess strong communication, presentation, organizational, time management, and interpersonal skills to effectively deliver work of high quality promptly
  • Should be able to perform both repetitive and miscellaneous tasks while maintaining a high level of accuracy in your work
  • Must be highly accountable, responsive, and have an excellent ability to meet deadlines
  • Great aptitude for working with people, problem-solving, and thinking critically / analytically
  • Possesses a growth and results-driven mindset, and can handle and implement constructive criticism
  • Any remote work experience is a major advantage
  • Excellent interpersonal skills to clearly and effectively communicate with clients as well as marketing professionals in our Service Department
  • Familiarity with working autonomously and managing your time (remote work experience is a plus)
  • Must be available and responsive during office hours (Mondays to Fridays between 3-6 PM BCN time)
  • Must have a stable internet connection and a laptop or PC, as well as be able to attend virtual video conferences
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English (you must be fluent in English, although English doesn't have to be your native language)
  • Being open to receiving feedback and constructive criticism and improving on it, as well as giving feedback of similar nature productively to your team

description:

About Us

Impact Advisors, LLC is a nationally recognized healthcare management consulting firm delivering Best in KLAS advisory, implementation, and optimization services. We are driven by a commitment to exceed client expectations and are proud to be a trusted partner to many of the nation's leading healthcare organizations. Our mission to drive patient-centered, value-driven outcomes has earned us prestigious industry accolades. To learn more about us, visit www.impact-advisors.com.


Job Overview

Impact Advisors is seeking an experienced Physician Enterprise Healthcare Consultant with expertise in revenue cycle management and ambulatory care to lead client-facing assessment, transformation, and implementation work. This consultant will partner with physician enterprise leaders to strengthen financial performance, standardize operations across multiple locations, improve the patient financial experience, and build sustainable capabilities across the front, middle, and back end of the revenue cycle.


Responsibilities

  • Engagement Leadership: Lead client workstreams from current-state assessment and opportunity sizing through workflow redesign, implementation, and performance sustainment.
  • Revenue Cycle Optimization: Assess and improve patient access, eligibility and benefits verification, prior authorization, treatment estimates, point-of-service collections, charge capture, coding, claims submission, payment posting, denial management, underpayment recovery, accounts receivable follow-up, refunds, and patient billing.
  • Financial Performance: Analyze revenue leakage and drive measurable improvements in net and gross collection rates, clean claim rate, days in accounts receivable, accounts receivable over 90 days, denial and write-off rates, appeal success, cash acceleration, and cost to collect.
  • Analytics and Reporting: Develop dashboards, benchmarks, root-cause analyses, business cases, executive presentations, implementation roadmaps, and performance monitoring routines that translate complex data into actionable recommendations.
  • Technology Enablement: Evaluate and optimize medical practice management systems, revenue cycle technologies, automation, and reporting tools to support standardized workflows and reliable data.
  • Stakeholder Partnership: Collaborate with executives, providers, operations, finance, clinical, credentialing, payer relations, information technology, and frontline teams to align priorities and implement sustainable change.

Qualifications

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in healthcare administration, business, finance, health information management, or a related field required; Master of Healthcare Administration, Master of Business Administration, or a related advanced degree preferred.
  • Experience: Progressive healthcare revenue cycle, physician enterprise, medical group, or consulting experience. Experience multi-site health group, or scaled ambulatory environment is strongly preferred.
  • Preferred Consulting Background: Demonstrated experience leading complex assessments, operational improvement initiatives, or technology-enabled transformations in client-facing or cross-functional environments.
  • Preferred Certifications: Healthcare Financial Management Association, American Association of Healthcare Administrative Management, Certified Revenue Cycle Representative, Certified Professional Coder, Lean Six Sigma, or project management credentials are preferred.

Skills and Competencies

  • Revenue Cycle Expertise: Deep knowledge of front-end, mid-cycle, and back-end workflows in physician enterprise settings.
  • Analytics: Advanced ability to interpret financial and operational data, identify root causes, quantify opportunities, and monitor results through meaningful key performance indicators.
  • Process Improvement: Strong skills in workflow assessment, standardization, operating model design, implementation planning, change management, and continuous improvement.
  • Client Leadership: Ability to build trusted relationships, facilitate executive and frontline discussions, manage multiple priorities, and lead cross-functional teams in complex environments.
  • Communication: Excellent written, verbal, presentation, and facilitation skills, with the ability to create polished, executive-ready deliverables.
  • Adaptability: Comfortable working independently, navigating ambiguity, learning new systems quickly, and balancing strategic thinking with hands-on execution.

Additional Information

  • Travel: This role requires intermittent travel to client sites, averaging approximately 80% based on engagement needs. Candidates must be comfortable with a weekly travel schedule and working across multiple time zones.
  • Work Schedule: Full-time, exempt, and remote-friendly when not traveling, with flexibility based on client and project demands.
  • Work Authorization: Must be authorized to work in the United States.

title: Engineer, Field Applications
description:
Come join Analog Devices (ADI) – a place where Innovation meets Impact. For more than 55 years, Analog Devices has been inventing new breakthrough technologies that transform lives. At ADI you will work alongside the brightest minds to collaborate on solving complex problems that matter from autonomous vehicles, drones and factories to augmented reality and remote healthcare.


ADI fosters a culture that focuses on employees through beneficial programs, aligned goals, continuous learning opportunities, and practices that create a more sustainable future.


About Analog Devices

Analog Devices, Inc. (NASDAQ: ADI) is a global semiconductor leader that bridges the physical and digital worlds to enable breakthroughs at the Intelligent Edge. ADI combines analog, digital, AI, and software technologies into solutions that combat climate change, reliably connect humans and the world, and help drive advancements in automation and robotics, mobility, healthcare, energy and data centers. With revenue of more than $11 billion in FY25, ADI ensures today's innovators stay Ahead of What's Possible. Learn more at and on LinkedIn and X.

EARLY CAREER PROGRAM
FIELD APPLICATIONS ENGINEER

Early Career Program | Customer-facing engineering and solution selling development


Early Career opportunity: Designed for recent graduates and early-career professionals. Approximately two years of relevant experience is preferred but not required. Start your career where engineering, customers and real-world innovation come together.

Are you ready to launch your engineering career and help shape the future? At Analog Devices (ADI), you’ll join a global leader at the intersection of the physical and digital worlds—where your curiosity, ideas, and drive can make a real difference. Our 12-month Early Career Program is your springboard to a permanent Field Applications Engineer role, offering hands-on experience, world-class mentorship, and the chance to work on technologies that power a smarter, safer, and more sustainable world.

Are You Ready to Accelerate Your Career Growth?

Are you a curious engineer who thrives on tackling complex challenges and learning new technologies? Do you enjoy collaborating with diverse teams and customers to solve real-world problems? If you’re excited by the prospect of working at the forefront of innovation—and eager to evolve with the rapidly changing world of AI and software—Analog Devices’ Early Career Program is designed for you.


About the Early Career Program

The Early Career Program combines continuous learning with practical customer and business experience. Through technical and commercial training, projects, job shadowing, mentoring and coaching, you will build the capabilities needed to grow within ADI's Sales organization. The program is suited to people who are curious, adaptable and motivated to continuously upskill as technology and customer needs evolve.


The Role

As an Early Career Field Applications Engineer (FAE), you will become a trusted technical partner to customers. Working with Sales, Business Units and Technology Groups, you will help understand system-level challenges, evaluate options, propose ADI solutions and support customer designs from early concept towards production. This is a customer-facing engineering role that combines technical depth, communication and commercial awareness.


What You Will Do

  • Understand customer needs: Understand customer systems and design goals through insightful questions and analysis.
  • Innovative Solutions: Translate customer needs into innovative system-level proposals using ADI’s cutting-edge products and platforms.
  • End-to-end support: Support customer designs from evaluation and debugging to production success.
  • Cross-Team Collaboration: Collaborate across Field Sales, Business Units, and technology groups to deliver the best outcomes.
  • Digital Acceleration: Leverage software, data, and AI tools to accelerate analysis and share insights that shape product strategy.
  • Continuously learn: Continuously upskill in technologies, applications, and the end-to-end customer design cycle.
  • Customer Empowerment: Educate and empower customers on Analog Devices’ advanced solutions.
  • Develop relationships: Build and nurture professional relationships with diverse stakeholders.
  • Innovation: Support the definition, design, and development of new products and tools.
  • Drive growth: Expand and develop customer accounts through consultative engagement.
  • Problem Solving: Apply best practices in customer support to resolve technical challenges.

What You Will Learn and Develop

  • System-level solution development and value-based technical engagement.
  • ADI product, technology and application knowledge across analog, digital, mixed-signal and software-enabled solutions.
  • Customer discovery, technical presentations, evaluation-board demonstrations and design support.
  • Practical use of software, data and AI tools to improve engineering effectiveness and customer outcomes.
  • Commercial awareness, opportunity development and cross-functional collaboration.

What You Bring

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s in Electrical/Electronic Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field.
  • Up to two years of work experience
  • High learning agility, curiosity, and a passion for technology and customer success.
  • Hands-on approach to electronics, lab measurement, debugging, or system design.
  • Analytical, creative problem-solving mindset.
  • Strong communication skills—able to make complex ideas simple and build trusted relationships.
  • Initiative, resilience, and organizational skills to balance priorities.
  • Entrepreneurial thinking and hands-on approach
  • Fluency in English and proficiency in German are required.
  • Ability to travel and a valid driving license and passport.

What Sets You Apart

We’re seeking agile, growth-minded engineers who:

  • Demonstrate learning agility and adaptability in fast-paced environments
  • Thrive in ambiguity and embrace change as an opportunity for growth
  • Exhibit a growth mindset—eager to learn, take initiative, and develop new skills
  • Quickly learn and apply new technologies to solve evolving customer challenges
  • Collaborate effectively with diverse teams and communicate with clarity
  • Show resilience and a positive attitude when facing new or complex problems
  • Are passionate about technology and innovation—especially in AI and software

Why Join ADI?

  • Work at the intersection of hardware, software, AI and real-world systems.
  • Learn from experienced sales, applications, business unit and technology colleagues.
  • Build customer-facing experience while contributing to solutions that create measurable impact.
  • Grow through continuous learning, coaching and exposure to diverse technologies, applications and markets.

Travel: Customer and program travel will be required.

Language: Fluent English and proficiency in German are required.


For positions requiring access to technical data, Analog Devices, Inc. may have to obtain export licensing approval from the U.S. Department of Commerce - Bureau of Industry and Security and/or the U.S. Department of State - Directorate of Defense Trade Controls. As such, applicants for this position – except US Citizens, US Permanent Residents, and protected individuals as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3) – may have to go through an export licensing review process.

Analog Devices is an equal opportunity employer. We foster a culture where everyone has an opportunity to succeed regardless of their race, color, religion, age, ancestry, national origin, social or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, marital status, pregnancy, parental status, disability, medical condition, genetic information, military or veteran status, union membership, and political affiliation, or any other legally protected group.

title: Implementation Analyst
description:
About Hedgerow Software:

Hedgerow provides cloud-based software solutions to local governments, aiming to make our communities better places to live and work. As a mission-driven company, we are committed to creating impactful technology that serves the public good. We seek team members who take pride in their work and consistently improve their skills and knowledge.

This role will focus on Hedgerow, GovPilot's environmental health software solution, which helps public health and environmental agencies streamline inspections, permitting, and compliance to protect the communities they serve.

What We Offer:

  • Competitive salary.
  • Flexible working hours and remote work options.
  • Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance.
  • Professional development opportunities and learning budget.
  • Supportive team environment.
  • The chance to work on innovative projects with cutting-edge technologies.

About the Role

The Implementation Analyst, part of the Hedgerow Software Professional Services team, supports end-to-end deployments of our SaaS application for public health and environmental agencies. Working alongside the Project Manager, you’ll guide customers through configuration, setup, data migration, and training to ensure successful adoption. Acting as both a project contributor and product expert, you’ll collaborate closely with clients to understand their business requirements and translate them into effective, scalable system solutions.

You will play a key role in ensuring each customer realizes measurable value from Hedgerow while receiving a seamless, high-quality onboarding experience. You’ll help clients rethink their business processes to get the most from the platform, and you’ll use AI tools to make implementations faster and more effective.

Key Requirements

  • Support the Project Manager in executing the implementation process for new Hedgerow customers, from kickoff through go-live.
  • Analyze and understand each customer’s business processes and apply best practices to guide how those processes translate into Hedgerow.
  • Become a product expert to configure the platform to match each agency’s specific workflows, data, and compliance requirements.
  • Strong understanding of SaaS platforms, cloud environments, and data management principles required.
  • Proficiency with tools such as Wrike, HubSpot, Salesforce, Jira, or other implementation-related platforms required.
  • Create custom reports using Hedgerow’s report writing tool, which often involves complex SQL stored procedures.
  • Train customer teams (inspectors, administrators, and staff) on how to use Hedgerow.
  • Identify and troubleshoot technical or process issues that arise during setup, escalating to the Project Manager as needed.
  • Use AI tools to accelerate documentation, data mapping, and configuration work, and help identify where AI can improve implementation speed and quality.
  • Document implementation processes and contribute to internal playbooks to improve future onboarding.

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in implementation or onboarding of SaaS solutions.
  • Ability to manage multiple customer implementations simultaneously.
  • Comfort working with data, including understanding data structures, interpreting datasets, and validating accuracy across systems
  • Working knowledge of SQL (queries and report writing across relational databases)
  • Comfort using AI tools (such as Claude or similar) to speed up data analyses, documentation, and configuration work
  • Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written, with the ability to translate technical concepts for non-technical government staff
  • Proficiency with tools like HubSpot, or similar CRM/project management platforms
  • A problem-solving mindset and comfort navigating ambiguity.

What Makes You Stand Out

  • Experience in Gov-Tech SaaS, public health, environmental health, or a related sector
  • Experience implementing SaaS solutions for local governments or public health/environmental agencies
  • Hands-on experience using AI tools to improve workflow efficiency (e.g., data transformation scripts, documentation generation, process automation).
  • Self-motivated, detail-oriented, and driven to see a project through to a successful launch.

Practicals

  • You'll report to: Manager of Professional Services | EH
  • Location: Remote (Canada)
  • Start date: As soon as possible
  • Salary Range: $90,000-$120,000 CAD. May be considered for a discretionary bonus
  • Status: Full Time
  • Please note: GovPilot is unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa at this time.

Application Process

  1. Screening call with a recruiter
  2. Hiring Manager Interview
  3. Technical/Team Panel Interview
  4. VP of CX Interview
  5. Final Interview with GovPilot CEO
  6. Reference Checks

How to Apply

If you are passionate about technology and eager to work on a dynamic team, we would love to hear from you. Please submit your resume and cover letter today!

Equal Opportunity Employer:

GovPilot is an equal opportunity employer and values diversity. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. It's important to us that our workforce reflects people of all backgrounds, identities, and experiences and by providing this data, if you choose to, it will help us to stay accountable.

Join us in creating amazing technology solutions that make a difference. Apply today!

description:

Tester Work is a global QA crowdsourcing platform that connects companies building digital products with a community of freelance testers worldwide. We help businesses improve their websites, mobile apps, and software by enabling real users to test products in real-world conditions and provide structured feedback.

As a tester, you’ll get access to flexible, project-based opportunities where you can earn money by executing test cases, exploring applications, and sharing usability feedback that helps improve digital products.

 

Overview

We are currently looking for QA testers to join our testing community. Once onboarded, you will gain access to our latest project and you'll be able to help us fine-tune a personal AI assistant developed by one of the biggest tech companies on the market. Besides, a variety of projects across different industries, including e-commerce, fintech, entertainment, and mobile applications, will also be available for you.

 

What You’ll Do

  • Follow step-by-step test cases to validate user flows (e.g., sign-up, login, checkout, payments)

  1. Switzerland (French and German speakers)
  2. Sweden (Native Swedish speakers)
  3. Luxembourg (English speakers)
  4. Belgium (Dutch and French speakers)
  5. Denmark (Native Danish speakers)
  6. Norway (Native Norwegian speakers)

  • Comfortable using websites, mobile apps and AI

What You Can Expect

  • Fully remote, flexible, project-based work
  • No fixed schedule, choose tasks based on your availability
  • Exposure to a wide range of digital products and industries
  • Opportunity to build QA/testing experience over time
  • Ongoing access to new testing cycles once onboarded

 

Compensation

  • Payment varies depending on project scope and complexity

  • All payments are processed securely via PayPal, Wise or Upwork 

 

If you enjoy exploring apps, identifying issues, and helping improve digital products, this is a great opportunity to gain experience and earn flexible income as part of a global testing community.

title: Quality Assurance Rater - Spanish speakers in Spain
description:
Join our elite team of Senior Raters as a critical contributor to high-quality validation data that directly influences product development and quality assurance for leading search engines and AI technologies.

This flexible, remote opportunity allows you to apply your analytical and research skills to evaluate search results and AI-generated content while contributing to the development of high-quality AI systems.

 

A Day in the Life of a Quality Assurance Rater

In this role, you'll conduct analytical assessments of search results and AI responses, providing ratings and feedback that help improve AI model performance and search quality.

Your work will maintain high quality standards and deliver the accuracy our clients depend on.

You'll evaluate a variety of rating tasks, analyze content with attention to detail, conduct research to support rating decisions, and identify guideline gaps or task inconsistencies.

You'll also participate in training and calibration sessions while contributing feedback to improve rating processes and guidelines.

 

Key Responsibilities

  • Evaluate search results and AI-generated content for quality, relevance, accuracy, and usefulness.
  • Conduct online research to verify information and support rating decisions.
  • Apply rating guidelines consistently while maintaining quality standards.
  • Document edge cases, guideline gaps, and task-related issues.
  • Provide clear written feedback and rationale for ratings when required.
  • Participate in training, calibration sessions, and ongoing quality reviews.
  • Meet productivity expectations while maintaining high-quality work.

 

TELUS Digital AI Community

Our global AI Community is a vibrant network of 1 million+ contributors from diverse backgrounds who help our customers collect, enhance, train, translate, and localize content to build better AI models. Become part of our growing community and make an impact supporting the machine learning models of some of the world’s largest brands. 

Qualification path

 

Candidates will complete project-specific training and qualification assessments before joining the program. Ongoing work will be subject to regular quality assurance reviews and performance monitoring.

 

Basic Requirements

  • Working as a freelancer with excellent communication skills in Spanish & English.
  • Resident in Spain for the last 5 consecutive years.
  • Familiarity with current and historical business, media, sports, news, social media, and cultural affairs.
  • Strong analytical thinking, attention to detail, and research skills.
  • Experience using web browsers, search engines, and online research tools.
  • Daily access to a reliable broadband internet connection, smartphone, and personal computer.
  • Demonstrated research capability through professional background OR strong track record of self-directed research and information verification
  • Ability to work independently and follow detailed guidelines consistently.
  • High level of creativity and logical skills with the ability to achieve consistent targets

 

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in quality assurance, content moderation, data annotation, research, journalism, editing, or information verification.

description:
Join our elite team of Senior Raters as a critical contributor to high-quality validation data that directly influences product development and quality assurance for leading search engines and AI technologies.

This flexible, remote opportunity allows you to apply your analytical and research skills to evaluate search results and AI-generated content while contributing to the development of high-quality AI systems.

 

A Day in the Life of a Quality Assurance Rater

In this role, you'll conduct analytical assessments of search results and AI responses, providing ratings and feedback that help improve AI model performance and search quality.

Your work will maintain high quality standards and deliver the accuracy our clients depend on.

You'll evaluate a variety of rating tasks, analyze content with attention to detail, conduct research to support rating decisions, and identify guideline gaps or task inconsistencies.

You'll also participate in training and calibration sessions while contributing feedback to improve rating processes and guidelines.

 

Key Responsibilities

  • Evaluate search results and AI-generated content for quality, relevance, accuracy, and usefulness.
  • Conduct online research to verify information and support rating decisions.
  • Apply rating guidelines consistently while maintaining quality standards.
  • Document edge cases, guideline gaps, and task-related issues.
  • Provide clear written feedback and rationale for ratings when required.
  • Participate in training, calibration sessions, and ongoing quality reviews.
  • Meet productivity expectations while maintaining high-quality work.

 

If hired we will ask you to submit a copy of your Independent Contractor Registration and/or Certificate of Vigilance. This documentation may be obtained from the URSSAF (Union de Recouvrement des Cotisations de Sécurité Sociale et d'Allocations Familiales) and also through https://www.guichet-entreprises.fr/.

 

TELUS Digital AI Community

Our global AI Community is a vibrant network of 1 million+ contributors from diverse backgrounds who help our customers collect, enhance, train, translate, and localize content to build better AI models. Become part of our growing community and make an impact supporting the machine learning models of some of the world’s largest brands. 

Qualification path

 

Candidates will complete project-specific training and qualification assessments before joining the program. Ongoing work will be subject to regular quality assurance reviews and performance monitoring.

 

Basic Requirements

  • Working as a freelancer with excellent communication skills in French & English.
  • Resident in France for the last 5 consecutive years.
  • Familiarity with current and historical business, media, sports, news, social media, and cultural affairs.
  • Strong analytical thinking, attention to detail, and research skills.
  • Experience using web browsers, search engines, and online research tools.
  • Daily access to a reliable broadband internet connection, smartphone, and personal computer.

  • Ability to work independently and follow detailed guidelines consistently.

Preferred Qualifications

title: US Remote Patient Care Advocate (Customer Service)
description:
Job Title: Patient Care Advocate 

Job Location: Remote


About Us: 

We are a dedicated team focused on improving access to affordable prescription medications for patients. By partnering with insurance companies, healthcare providers, and pharmacies, we work to reduce the financial burden of medications, ensuring that patients can access the treatments they need without excessive costs. 


Role Overview: 

As a key member of our team, you will help patients navigate our Prescription Payment Plan. This involves working closely with patients, insurance providers, healthcare professionals, and pharmacies to ensure seamless enrollment, eligibility verification, cost-sharing, and prescription fulfillment. 


What You’ll Do: 

  • Patient Enrollment & Eligibility: Assist patients with enrolling in the program, ensuring all necessary personal and insurance information is provided and verifying eligibility. 
  • Prescription Coverage: Help patients confirm that their prescribed medications are covered under the program, and manage the approval process for eligible medications. 
  • Cost-Sharing & Payment: Reduce patients' out-of-pocket costs by applying the program benefits. Manage copayments, coinsurance, and assist with additional copay assistance when applicable. 
  • Prescription Fulfillment: Coordinate with participating pharmacies to ensure the correct application of benefits during prescription filling, ensuring patients pay the reduced amount. 
  • Refills & Continued Use: Support patients by ensuring they continue receiving medications at reduced costs, monitoring adherence to medication regimens, and ensuring continued eligibility. 
  • Program Renewal & Updates: Guide patients through annual renewals and inform them about any updates to the program or medication formulary. 


What We’re Looking For: 

  • High school diploma or GED required
  • Experience in healthcare, insurance or customer service required (experience with prescription assistance programs is a plus)
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to navigate complex processes
  • Excellent communication skills for working with patients, healthcare providers, and pharmacies
  • A genuine passion for helping others and making a positive impact on their healthcare access
  • The ability to work efficiently and collaboratively within a team environment

Success Factors for Working from Home 

  • Private Workspace: A dedicated, quiet workspace with a door that closes, free from ambient noise. 
  • Ergonomics: A comfortable desk and chair setup that allows for the proper installation of necessary equipment. 
  • Reliable Internet Connection: Stable, high-speed internet with a minimum bandwidth of 10 Mbps downstream and 5 Mbps upstream. 
  • Quiet, Distraction-Free Workspace: A dedicated, quiet area where you can focus on delivering excellent customer service without interruptions. 
  • Tech-Savvy: Comfort with technology and ability to learn new systems quickly. 
  • Self-motivation & Independence: Ability to stay productive and manage your time effectively in a remote environment. 
  • Communication Skills: Strong verbal and written communication skills, especially in a virtual setting. 
  • Adaptability: Ability to adapt to changing technologies and procedures while working remotely. 


Compensation & Perks 

  • Hourly Pay: $16.50 per hour 
  • Company-Provided Equipment: All necessary equipment will be provided. 
  • Comprehensive Benefits: Full health insurance package including medical, dental, and vision coverage. 
  • Cell Phone Benefits: $25/month per line for unlimited phone, text, and data (restrictions may apply). 
  • Generous Referral Program: Earn $50 per paycheck for every person you refer—and your referral earns it too! No limits on payouts. 
  • Comprehensive Training: Paid training to ensure you are fully prepared for success. 
  • Career Growth: Opportunities for career advancement and professional development within a leading healthcare provider. 
  • Work-from-Home Convenience: Save time, and money, and reduce your environmental footprint. 
  • Inclusive Culture: We are an Equal Opportunity Employer, including individuals with disabilities and veterans. 

What Success Looks Like: 

  • Reduced out-of-pocket costs for patients through effective cost-sharing and copay assistance 
  • Timely and accurate processing of prescription claims and approvals 
  • High patient satisfaction with the program’s support and streamlined experience 
  • Compliance with program requirements and monitoring of patient eligibility for ongoing assistance 

Why Join Us? 

  • Be part of a team that makes a real difference in patients' lives by reducing the cost of necessary medications 
  • Opportunity for professional growth in the healthcare and insurance sectors 
  • Competitive compensation and benefits package 
  • A collaborative, supportive, and innovative work culture 

Ready to Make an Impact? 

Join us in making prescription medications more affordable and accessible for those who need them most. If you're ready to help make a difference, we'd love to hear from you! 

If you like wild growth and working with happy, enthusiastic over-achievers, you'll enjoy your career with us!

title: Front End Developer
description:
Job Title: Front-End Developer
Location: Fully Remote (US)
Department: Global Enrollment Marketing and Sales
Reports to: Director of Web Development
Classification: Regular, Full-time
FLSA Status: Exempt
Prepared by: Global Head of Creative
Prepared Date: 10/1/26
Salary range: $85,000â$100,000


About Edconic

Edconic is a leading player in the alternative, experiential education space. We partner with the world's largest and most well-known brands to create and run schools that capture the legacy and value of each brand. Our students get truly unique, once-in-a-lifetime experiences that help shape their future and give them the skills they need to reach their goals.

The Role

We're looking for an experienced Front-End Developer to join our web team, which owns every Edconic digital property â from our school websites to landing pages and email templates. You'll work alongside designers, IT, and MarTech to build solutions that serve real business needs while protecting each brand's unique identity.

You'll be one of two developers on the team, working directly with our lead developer. That means real ownership of your work, a genuine voice in how we build, very little process overhead, and a codebase that is actively moving toward a modern, standardized WordPress stack. We value craft: fast pages and code that the next developer can read.

What You'll Do

  • Build and maintain public-facing websites, micro-sites, and landing pages in collaboration with our lead developer, IT, and MarTech.
  • Work with UX/UI designers to confirm the technical feasibility of designs, then translate them into polished, responsive pages that stay true to each brand.
  • Build and maintain custom WordPress themes across both of our stacks: modern block-based builds (ACF Blocks, core blocks, block patterns, theme.json) and established classic themes built on PHP templates, Advanced Custom Fields, and Sass.
  • Collaborate with our lead developer to shape the team's coding standards, tooling, and workflow, and help migrate our existing sites toward our new modern stack.
  • Stay current on emerging web standards and bring ideas to the table where they genuinely fit.

What You Bring

  • 4+ years of front-end web development experience, with strong skills in semantic HTML, CSS, JavaScript, PHP, and WordPress.
  • The ability to build a custom WordPress theme from scratch using PHP templates and Advanced Custom Fields.
  • Strong CSS skills across Sass and modern native CSS (custom properties, nesting), and solid vanilla JavaScript.
  • Comfort working in Git/GitHub with pull requests and code reviews, and with npm-based build tools and the command line.
  • A habit of writing semantic, well-structured HTML that covers accessibility basics, with an eye for reuse, cross-browser compatibility, performance, and SEO.
  • Experience building and testing HTML emails.
  • Strong UX/UI sensibilities and a desire to sweat the small stuff.
  • A proactive, self-directed working style â you can run with a project independently and prioritize across several at once.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication â you're positive, collaborative, objective, and solution-oriented.

Bonus Experience

  • Modern WordPress block development: ACF Blocks, block.json, theme.json, and block patterns.
  • Composer, Bedrock or other Roots tooling (Sage/Blade, Trellis), Vite, or CI/CD with GitHub Actions.
  • Deeper accessibility experience (WCAG, ARIA, assistive-technology testing).
  • CRM and marketing automation integration (Salesforce, Pardot/Account Engagement).
  • Multilingual WordPress sites.
  • A modern JavaScript framework such as React or Vue.
  • UX or UI design, and design tools such as Figma and Adobe Creative Suite.


How We Use AI

AI-assisted development is a new and evolving part of our workflow. We use AI coding tools to speed up research, scaffolding, review, and routine work, and you're welcome to do the same.

AI is a tool here, not a substitute for expertise. You are accountable for every line of code that you ship, which means you must be able to write, review, debug, and explain production code entirely on your own. Expect to demonstrate those skills without AI assistance during the interview process.

Location, Travel & Eligibility

  • Fully remote within the United States. Occasional travel to our New York office may be required.
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the US.
  • Bachelor's degree preferred (Computer Science, Interaction Design, Graphic Design, Communications, or a related field); equivalent professional experience is equally welcome.

Our Commitment

Edconic supports and embraces diversity and inclusiveness, and we encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply, even if you don't meet every requirement listed here. Reasonable accommodations are available to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the role and to participate in the interview process.

The above statements describe the general nature and level of work for this position. They are not an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, and skills. Edconic reserves the right to modify this job description at its sole discretion.

title: CTO - BeReal
description:
About Voodoo

Founded in 2013, Voodoo is a tech company that creates mobile games and apps with a mission to entertain the world. Gathering 800 employees, 7 billion downloads, and over 200 million active users, Voodoo is the #3 mobile publisher worldwide in terms of downloads after Google and Meta. Our portfolio includes chart-topping games like Mob Control and Block Jam, alongside popular apps such as BeReal and Wizz.

Team

BeReal stands for authenticity in social media: one notification a day, unfiltered photos and videos, real friends. 40M+ people use BeReal every month, and they all post at the same moment. Since joining Voodoo, BeReal has returned to growth with a healthy business model and $50M in revenue this year. The opportunity is clear: people want an alternative to Instagram and TikTok. Our ambition is to make BeReal the leader in authentic social, used by hundreds of millions.

Role

We are looking for an exceptional technologist to define the next generation of BeReal's technology.

You will go deep with our strongest engineers, challenge technical decisions across Mobile and Backend, lead major transformations, raise the technical level of the organization, and define how AI changes the way BeReal engineers build software.

You report directly to BeReal's CEO.

What you'll do:

  • Define BeReal's long-term technical direction across Mobile, Backend, Data and infrastructure.

  • Lead the transformation of a large native mobile application carrying significant legacy architecture.

  • Set technical principles that allow teams to move quickly without degrading reliability, performance or maintainability.

  • Challenge the hardest technical decisions alongside Staff-level engineers.

  • Raise technical standards across the organization without centralizing every decision.

  • Ensure BeReal remains reliable under highly concentrated traffic spikes from tens of millions of users.

  • Guide major migrations and decide when to evolve incrementally vs rewrite.

  • Define how AI transforms coding, testing, debugging, migrations, architecture and developer tooling.

  • Partner with the CEO and engineering leadership on BeReal's most important technical bets.

Our stack

GCP, Kubernetes, Terraform, ArgoCD, Datadog, Fastly · Go (some legacy Node.js), Cloud Spanner, Redis, PostgreSQL, Pub/Sub · Swift/SwiftUI, Kotlin · BigQuery, Airflow, DBT, Amplitude

Profile

  • Exceptional technical track record.

  • Architect-level depth; able to challenge excellent Staff / Principal engineers.

  • Deep understanding of native mobile engineering.

  • Strong Backend and distributed-systems fundamentals at consumer scale.

  • Proven experience with significant legacy transformations.

  • Evidence of raising the technical level of an engineering organization, not just designing systems personally.

  • Strong production judgment: reliability, failure modes, performance and scale.

  • Strong judgment around technical investment, prioritization and rewrite vs migration.

  • Practical point of view on AI applied to software engineering.

  • Experience with high-scale consumer products or comparable high-throughput systems.

  • Strong product sense and excellent communication.

Benefits

  • Competitive salary upon experience

  • Swile Lunch voucher

  • Gymlib (100% borne by Voodoo)

  • Premium healthcare coverage SideCare, for your family 100% borne by Voodoo

  • Wellness activities in our Paris office

title: Remote Office Assistant
description:
Coalition Technologies is seeking a reliable, detail-oriented, and highly organized Remote Office Assistant to support administrative, bookkeeping, billing, reporting, data entry, and internal operations tasks. This role is ideal for someone with strong communication skills, discretion, attention to detail, and a willingness to learn and grow within a fast-paced remote work environment.

As an Office Assistant, you will help support daily administrative operations, assist with entry-level bookkeeping, organize client documents, support internal reporting, and help maintain accurate company records. This position offers strong growth potential for the right candidate, including opportunities for advancement within the Accounting team or other departments.

We are looking for talented and diligent candidates who perform well on our skills assessments. Strong skills test performance may be considered even if a candidate does not meet every preferred experience or educational background requirement.

 

Why Join Coalition Technologies?

Coalition Technologies is committed to delivering high-quality work for our clients while providing our team with a fun, thriving, innovative, and growth-focused work environment. We offer:

  • 100% remote work with a company that has supported remote team members for more than a decade
  • Competitive profit-sharing bonus plan, with up to 50% of company profits paid to full-time employees each month
  • Competitive Paid Time Off plan that supports work-life balance
  • Subsidized gym memberships
  • Medical, dental, vision, and life insurance packages for eligible US-based team members
  • International Health Insurance Reimbursement Program for eligible international team members
  • Device upgrade and learning reimbursement programs
  • Career development plans with clearly defined goals and rewards
  • Additional job-specific incentives and bonuses

 

Office Assistant Responsibilities

As an Office Assistant, your duties will include:

  • Answering phones and emails
  • Completing entry-level bookkeeping tasks, including recording expenses, organizing receipts, and maintaining transaction records
  • Resolving billing issues with clients and internal team members
  • Providing account access, usage reports, data analysis, and other ad hoc support for team members
  • Supporting quality assurance checks for internal and client-facing reports
  • Organizing new client contracts, creating invoices, and processing client payments
  • Contributing to internal database maintenance, upkeep, and data entry
  • Researching, ordering, and distributing company-wide gifts two to three times per year
  • Organizing company events, competitions, and special projects throughout the year
  • Facilitating company holiday calendars, time-off calendars, and schedule variation calendars

 

Required Skills and Qualifications

The ideal candidate will have:

  • Willingness to learn, grow, and collaborate with the team and company as a whole
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • High level of discretion, ethics, and trustworthiness
  • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills
  • Ability to support administrative, bookkeeping, billing, reporting, and data entry tasks
  • Innovative thinking and willingness to challenge existing methods when improvement is possible
  • Availability to work 40 hours per week, Monday through Friday, 9:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m. Pacific Time
  • Reliable remote workspace with a fast computer, quality internet, camera, microphone, and speakers

 

Preferred Skills

  • The following experience is preferred but not required:
  • Intermediate spreadsheet skills
  • Experience with bookkeeping or financial record keeping
  • Experience with Google Sheets, Microsoft Excel, QuickBooks Online, and Google Workspace
  • Experience supporting billing, invoicing, reporting, data entry, or administrative operations

 

Remote Work Environment

Coalition Technologies is a fully remote company. Our team works remotely with the support of time tracking software, structured communication, and a company culture designed to help remote team members succeed. We have supported remote team members for more than a decade and welcome qualified applicants from around the world.

 

Growth Opportunity

This position offers a strong opportunity for growth. Successful Office Assistants at Coalition Technologies have advanced quickly and earned promotions within the Accounting team and across other departments.

 

Compensation

For candidates located in California, New York, Washington, and Colorado, the starting base pay for this position ranges from $15 to $25 per hour. Compensation may vary based on factors such as experience, qualifications, skills test performance, geographic location, and seniority of the position offered. For candidates outside of California, New York, Washington, and Colorado, compensation may fall outside the listed range.

title: IT-Systemadministrator (m/w/d)
description:
AeroDesignWorks ist Hersteller von Strahltriebwerken und Kleingasturbinen sowie ein spezialisiertes Engineering-Unternehmen für die Entwicklung und Optimierung von Turbomaschinen. Als Teil der MTU Aero Engines AG verbinden wir die Flexibilität eines mittelständischen Unternehmens mit der technologischen Stärke einer international führenden Unternehmensgruppe. An unserem Standort in Köln entwickeln und fertigen wir anspruchsvolle Antriebssysteme für unbemannte Luftfahrtsysteme und industrielle Anwendungen.

Wen suchen wir?

Wir suchen zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt einen IT-Systemadministrator (m/w/d), der unsere IT-Infrastruktur zuverlässig betreut, unsere Engineering-Teams bei anspruchsvollen technischen Anwendungen unterstützt und unsere Systemlandschaft aktiv weiterentwickelt.

Ihre Aufgabenbereiche:

  • Administration und Weiterentwicklung unserer IT-Infrastruktur, Netzwerke, Server und Arbeitsplatzsysteme

  • Betreuung unserer Engineering- und HPC-IT einschließlich Rechenressourcen, Workstations und Simulationssoftware

  • Verwaltung von Windows- und Linux-Systemen, Microsoft 365, Benutzerkonten und Berechtigungen

  • Installation und Wartung von Hard- und Software einschließlich Lizenzmanagement

  • IT-Support für unsere Mitarbeitenden sowie Analyse und Behebung technischer Störungen

  • Sicherstellung von IT-Sicherheit, Datensicherung und Systemverfügbarkeit

  • Betreuung externer IT-Dienstleister und Dokumentation der IT-Systeme

  • Unterstützung bei der Beschaffung von IT-Ausstattung und Software

  • Mitwirkung bei der Digitalisierung und Optimierung interner Prozesse

Wir bieten:

  • Sicherheit & Perspektive: Ein zukunftsorientierter Arbeitsplatz mit der Stärke und dem Rückhalt der MTU-Gruppe.

  • Ihre Zukunft im Blick: Betriebliche Altersvorsorge für Ihre langfristige Absicherung.

  • Stillstand? Nicht bei uns! Weiterbildung, persönliche Entwicklung und individuelle Aufstiegsmöglichkeiten.

  • Exklusive Mitarbeitervorteile: Attraktive Rabatte und Sonderkonditionen bei bekannten Marken, Reisen, Freizeitangeboten und Dienstleistungen.

  • Gemeinsam mehr erleben: Regelmäßige Teamevents stärken unseren Zusammenhalt und sorgen auch abseits des Arbeitsalltags für gemeinsame Erlebnisse.

  • Mobil mit dem Job-Bike: Nachhaltig unterwegs – im Alltag und in der Freizeit.

  • Miteinander statt nebeneinander: Ein kollegiales Team, gegenseitige Unterstützung und ein angenehmes Betriebsklima.

  • Kurze Wege, schnelle Entscheidungen: Flache Hierarchien, direkte Kommunikation und Raum für eigene Ideen.

  • Technologie, die begeistert: Ein modernes Arbeitsumfeld mit vielseitigen technischen Herausforderungen.

  • Gut versorgt: Kostenlose Kaffeebar und Wasser für Ihren Arbeitsalltag.

  • Abgeschlossene IT-Ausbildung oder vergleichbare Qualifikation. Engagierte Quereinsteiger mit fundierter IT-Erfahrung sind ebenfalls willkommen.

  • Aufgrund unseres Tätigkeitsfeldes gelten bei AeroDesignWorks besondere Anforderungen an Vertraulichkeit, Informationssicherheit und Exportkontrolle. Je nach Position und Aufgabenbereich können zusätzliche Sicherheitsprüfungen oder Freigabeverfahren erforderlich sein.

  • Gute Kenntnisse in Windows- und Linux-Systemen, Microsoft 365 und Netzwerktechnik

  • Praktische Erfahrung in der Systemadministration, im IT-Support und in der Fehleranalyse

  • Grundverständnis für High Performance Computing (HPC) sowie Engineering- und Simulationsanwendungen

  • Kenntnisse in Clusteradministration, Job-Scheduling (z. B. Slurm), CAD-/CAE-Anwendungen oder Skriptsprachen (Python, Bash, PowerShell) sind wünschenswert aber kein must-have

  • Teamfähigkeit, Eigeninitiative, Zuverlässigkeit und Kommunikationsstärke

  • Gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift für die fachliche Abstimmung

title: Robot Operator
description:
About Enact

The next defining technological breakthrough will be in the physical world. We stand at a historical inflection point: bringing general-purpose intelligence into robotics.

At Enact we rethink the entire robotic tech stack from model architectures and data pipelines, to the actuators and sensors that feed the model. Pushing beyond pure vision and language approaches, we build a proprioceptive nerve system, and the cortex that makes sense of it, to solve dexterity through whole-body force-awareness and deploy robots for thousands of tasks in industry and beyond.

We are shaping a company where brilliant and unconventional people thrive together on solving the hardest challenges of our time. We are truth seekers. We reason from first principles, test our beliefs against reality, and trust that the best ideas can come from anyone. We move fast. We care deeply about our work and colleagues and are driven by passion to change the status quo.

If this resonates, we're excited to hear from you.

In This Role

You will be the key connector between the digital and physical world. You will physically guide and remotely operate (teleoperate) state-of-the-art robots using motion-capture systems. Your physical demonstrations will directly form the training data our neural networks use to learn complex, real-world tasks. You will teach the AI what good looks like.

  • Data Capture & Teleoperation: Perform high-volume task demonstrations (e.g., sorting objects, operating tools, door opening, manual assembly, cable manipulation) via motion tracking equipment.

  • Quality Assurance: Monitor data stream quality, tag trajectory metadata, and flag anomalies or edge-case physical behaviors to the AI engineering team.

  • Hardware & Setup Maintenance: Assist with staging environments, changing end-effectors, suggest hardware/software improvements and basic routine maintenance on the robot fleet.

  • Cross-Functional Feedback: Work directly with AI researchers and robotics engineers to iterate on teleoperation controls and data acquisition pipelines.

What We're Looking For

  • Comfortable piloting various robots for extended duration.

  • Strong hand-eye coordination, spatial awareness, and fine motor control.

  • Attention to Detail: A preference for an organized, functional workspace and a systematic approach to engineering tasks.

  • Fluent in English (spoken), with strong interpersonal and communication skills.

Bonus Points If You Have

  • Tech-savviness with basic Linux commands, data logging tools, or troubleshooting equipment.

  • Experience in gaming, RC piloting, or mechanical assembly is a plus

What we offer

  • A world-class in-person setup in central Zürich, with excellent prototyping, robotics, and technical infrastructure for hands-on builders

  • Ownership from day one, with the ability to iterate quickly and see your impact firsthand in an early-stage startup

  • Opportunity to go beyond data capturing and moving into fleet operations

  • The opportunity to make a real impact working on some of the biggest challenges of our time

  • Visa sponsorship & relocation benefits to hire the best in the world

  • Competitive compensation

title: Growth Marketer, Nino
description:
Overview

CoinTracker is on a mission to unlock everyone's financial potential so they can build the life they want. We started with crypto, building the tax and portfolio tools that millions of users trust to trade digital assets with peace of mind. Nino builds the next layer of financial fluency for our users. Nino is an AI-powered financial operating system that makes comprehensive, expert-level tax and financial planning advice accessible.

More on Nino: Comprehensive tax and financial planning strategies are currently locked behind high AUM fees or require enough wealth to have a family office. We are turning expert judgment into software so we can serve millions. AI is going to redefine how people understand their finances and how tax advice gets delivered. Not in ten years, in 2026. You can help define that, or spend the next few years adapting to rules someone else wrote. Nino sits inside CoinTracker ($100M raised, partnered with Coinbase, TurboTax, H&R Block, and Thomson Reuters) with the autonomy of an early-stage startup and the reach of an established platform.

Your mission

As Growth Lead, you'll own how the right households find us and book a first conversation with our team. You'll run the website, paid search, AI search and SEO, and our channel with CoinTracker, and you'll ship the work yourself with AI coding tools. Our CPAs, Financial Planners, and sales team close. Your job is to fill their calendars with the right people.

Location: Remote in the US; California preferred.

Your one-year outcomes

  • The right households find us. Qualified consultations held with our team grow 10% week over week, and each channel pays for itself.

  • We know what works. Every consultation traces back to where it came from, and the team trusts the weekly numbers.

  • More than one engine. Paid search, AI search and SEO, and CoinTracker each bring in consultations. No single channel carries the business.

  • Nino is the answer. When people ask ChatGPT, Perplexity, or Google about flat-fee tax and financial planning, Nino shows up.

What you will do

  • Own the funnel from first visit to a held consultation. Set the plan, pick the channels, and own the number.

  • Ship the website yourself. Build and test landing pages, calculators, and comparison pages in our codebase with AI coding tools. No ticket queue.

  • Run paid acquisition. Google Ads first, then continuous experiments across new channels to find what scales.

  • Make Nino the answer in AI search. Content, comparison pages, reviews, and offsite authority, with an agency you direct.

  • Grow the CoinTracker channel. Work with the CoinTracker team to reach its users with the right offer at the right time.

  • Close the gap between booked and held. Scheduling, reminders, and qualification so more booked calls turn into real conversations.

What we look for

  • Role-agnostic

    • Opportunity alignment: You want to bring expert tax and financial advice to households that have outgrown doing it themselves, and you want to do it at an early-stage company where your work moves the number.

    • High agency: You see what needs doing and do it. You don't wait for a brief, a budget, or an engineer.

title: Supervising Physician for California
description:
About Dreem Health, by Sunrise

Dreem Health is America’s leading digital sleep clinic. Powered by Sunrise’s technology, Dreem Health makes sleep care simple — replacing long waits and in-lab sleep studies with home-based testing, expert telehealth visits, and personalized treatment plans that are easy for patients to follow. We’re fixing the broken sleep care journey and helping more people get the care they need — from home, on their schedule.

Your opportunity

As an MD at Dreem Health, you're transforming how sleep care is delivered—bringing high-quality, evidence-based treatment to patients through a modern, fully remote platform. Our clinical model offers the best of both worlds: the flexibility to work from home with no commute or unnecessary admin burden, and the opportunity to make a real impact at scale.

Unlike traditional sleep clinics—where providers are often tied to 36+ hours of patient visits and limited in scope—our clinicians focus on just 20 hours of patient care per week, with additional time dedicated to interpretation, collaboration, and contributing to the growth of our model. You’re not just a cog in the wheel—you’ll help shape the way sleep medicine is practiced nationally.

We’re growing fast and on track to become the largest sleep provider in the U.S.. If you're passionate about clinical excellence, excited by innovation, and interested in mentoring the next generation of sleep clinicians, Dreem Health is the place to grow your career.

What you bring

  • M.D. with a preference of experience in family medicine, ENT, neurology, or anesthesiology
  • Must be licensed in CA and at least one additional state
  • Board Certified in Sleep Medicine
  • 1+ years in sleep medicine or sleep fellowship completion
  • Startup mindset: Scrappy, solutions-oriented, and hands-on, with strong clinical training and a “build, test, learn” approach—not bound by traditional care models.
  • Comfort in navigating ambiguity, shifting priorities, and fast-paced environments.
  • Proficient with EMRs, digital health tools, and telemedicine platforms.
  • A genuine passion for improving healthcare access and patient outcomes

What makes you stand out

  • Can inspire teams, lead with vision, and guide clinical standards—even without formal authority.
  • Works well across teams and stakeholders (product, engineering, ops, marketing) and explains clinical insights in a clear, non-jargon way.
  • Open to feedback and co-creating processes with non-clinical teammates.
  • Exceptional communication skills
  • Adaptability in a fast-growing healthcare tech environment

About our Team

At Sunrise Group, we’re tackling real sleep health challenges that affect millions. We keep things clear and simple ✨, value trust and collaboration 🤝, and lead with optimism and compassion 🌞. These values guide everything we do. If you’re looking for the autonomy to take ownership of your work, make an impact, and be part of a team where ideas move fast and everyone has a voice, Sunrise might just be the right fit.

What we offer

  • Be part of an international team across the US, Paris, Belgium, and Vienna
  • Remote work
  • Comprehensive health benefits (medical, dental, vision)
  • 401(k) with company match
  • 20 days PTO + 10 paid holidays + sick leave
  • FREE One Medical membership
  • Internet reimbursement

We hire humans, not bullet points. Don’t meet every single qualification? That’s okay. We care more about who you are than what’s on your CV. We’re looking for people who are curious, resourceful, and ready to roll up their sleeves — especially if you’re excited about building something new in healthcare. So if you think you could make an impact here, reach out to us.

Dreem Health / Sunrise is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We welcome people of all backgrounds and are committed to building a workplace where everyone feels included and respected. We do not tolerate discrimination or harassment of any kind.

Business Development Representative (Commercial Branding and Transportation)


Collaborate with Innovative 3Mers Around the World

Choosing where to start and grow your career has a major impact on your professional and personal life, so it’s equally important you know that the company that you choose to work at, and its leaders, will support and guide you.   • Willingness to make the call. Relentless approach to developing new business for 3M.

Work location: This role follows a remote working model.

Must be legally authorized to work in country of employment without sponsorship for employment visa status (e.g., H1B status).

description:
Overview

We are hiring Quality Control (QC) evaluators for a project that spans both Search and Linguistic tasks. You will perform quality checks on initial ratings produced by evaluators—validating user intent assessment, query annotation, text classification, and multimedia (video, image, audio) reviews for relevanc, accuracy, and guideline adherence. The ideal candidate combines strong language skills with sharp analytical judgment, excellent documentation and feedback skills, and familiarity with short-form video culture.

What you will do

  • Audit samples of initial ratings for relevance, intent alignment, taxonomy compliance, and linguistic quality.
  • Re-rate items (double-scoring) to verify labels; resolve discrepancies and document decisions.
  • Perform linguistic quality checks (grammar, tone, clarity, local relevance) and media comprehension reviews.
  • Classify and track errors using an agreed error taxonomy; surface trends and edge cases.
  • Provide clear, actionable feedback to evaluators; contribute to guideline clarifications and updates.
  • Participate in and lead calibration sessions to drive inter-rater agreement.
  • Track and report QC metrics (e.g., agreement rates, accuracy, error trends) and meet QC SLAs.
  • Triage escalations, handle ambiguous cases, and ensure data integrity and compliance.
  • Use internal tools to complete, track, and submit QC tasks accurately.

Project Details

    Engagement Type: Freelance

    Rate: USD 28.61/hour

    Estimated Hours: 15-30 hours/week

Requirement

  • Native or near-native speaker level in English language with strong reading, writing, and listening comprehension.
  • Excellent grammar, writing, and proofreading skills.
  • Strong video and image comprehension; good hearing ability for audio tasks.
  • Solid understanding of search engines, user intent, and web content.
  • High attention to detail, consistency, and guideline adherence.
  • Ability to deliver clear written feedback and rationale.

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience in QC/QA for text classification, query annotation, data labeling, or search quality evaluation.
  • Familiarity with short dramas and local short-drama culture/platforms.
  • Experience with calibrations, sampling, scorecards, and root-cause analysis.
  • Comfortable working with productivity and quality targets; proficient with spreadsheets/QA tools.
  • Background in linguistics, communications, media studies, information science, or related field.

title: MSK Teletherapy Physical Therapist / PTA — Elizabethtown, NC
description:
Treat PeteDME’s MSK Integrated Care patients from home. Our program pairs knee and lumbar bracing with physical therapy and remote therapeutic monitoring, delivered through a network of in-home therapists. Remote visits and monitoring are paid per visit and per call.

How you join
Every therapist on the remote caseload starts with six in-person brace fittings on patients from your own current caseload, so you know the devices you will be coaching patients on. Each fitting is a paid clinical visit — intake, fitting, and follow-up — at a flat fee agreed in writing before your first patient. We give you a one-page screening tool to identify candidates among the patients you already see, and we handle the prescription, benefit verification, and the paperwork.

This is not a sales role. We do not ask you to refer; you treat patients you already see.

After six fittings
Teletherapy patient referrals from PeteDME begin: our patients, work from home, on your schedule, paid per visit and per call.

What you get
• Free specialized training and certification in orthopedic bracing.
• AI-generated SOAP notes — no new EMR to learn.
• Keep your current job. This is additional, independent-contractor work alongside it.
• Flat fees fixed in advance; no part of your pay depends on volume or on referrals.

Requirements

    • Active physical therapist or physical therapist assistant license in the state where you practice.
    • Currently working in home health or another in-home setting.
    • You evaluate and provide treatment.

How to apply

    Complete the short questionnaire. It asks about your license, your setting, and your caseload, and it asks you to acknowledge that teletherapy referrals begin after six fittings. A clinical onboarding specialist will reach out within one business day.

title: SBO Claims Operations Analyst
description:
Pay range: $62,316 - $93,454 annually, based on experience.

In addition, this role is eligible to work remotely from an approved state by St. Charles (please refer to the list). If you do not reside in an approved listed state (or do not plan to relocate to an approved listed state) we request, you do not apply for this particular position.

Approved states by St. Charles: Oregon, Arizona, Arkansas, Florida, Idaho, Missouri, Montana, Nevada, New Mexico, North Carolina, Oklahoma, Tennessee, Utah, and Wisconsin.

This position is eligible for comprehensive benefits that includes medical, dental, vision, a 403(b) retirement plan, and a generous Earned Time Off (ETO) program.

ST. CHARLES HEALTH SYSTEM

JOB DESCRIPTION

TITLE: SBO Claims Operations Analyst 1

REPORTS TO POSITION: Claims Manager

DEPARTMENT: Single Billing Office

DATE LAST REVIEWED: 11/04/2026

OUR VISION: Creating America’s healthiest community, together

OUR MISSION: In the spirit of love and compassion, better health, better care, better value

OUR VALUES: Accountability, Caring and Teamwork

DEPARTMENTAL SUMMARY: The Single Billing Office (SBO) at St. Charles Health System (SCHS) provides revenue cycle services to our multi-hospital and medical group organization focusing on billing, collecting, and posting revenue. The goal of the SBO is to deliver a delightful, transparent, and seamless experience to patients and customers that captures and collects the revenue earned by SCHS in a quality, efficient and timely manner.Services include but are not limited to: billing insurance claims, posting insurance and patient payments, resolving insurance denials, collecting unpaid insurance claims, maintaining payer contracts in the EMR, resolving under and over payments, identifying and resolving payer issues, processing refunds, processing financial assistance applications, billing patients, resolving patient accounts including patient questions, and vendor management: lockbox, clearinghouse, early out, collection agencies.

POSITION OVERVIEW: The SBO Claims Operations Analyst 1 position is responsible for identifying and resolving EHR issues that impact SBO functions including billing, payment posting, and denials resolution. The analyst position has advanced technical responsibilities including system build. This position must obtain and maintain an Epic department builder certification. The caregiver must have a strong working knowledge of IT principles, EHR workflows and functionality, insurance payers, reimbursement methodologies, and the complete lifecycle of a claim. The caregiver must have a strong working knowledge of IT principles, EHR workflows and functionality, insurance payers, reimbursement methodologies, and the complete claim cycle.

This position does not directly supervise caregivers, however may be asked to review and provide feedback on the work of SBO caregivers.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS AND DUTIES:

Actively works with SBO management, IT, and other departments to improve processes, increase accuracy, and create efficiencies within the EHR.

Completes EHR build tasks within certification scope.

Works with SCHS IT team to determine appropriate resolution to operational requirements and issues.

Works directly with Epic Technical Support to determine appropriate resolution to operational requirements and issues.

Coordinates and assists in the daily operations of SBO.

Maintains an advanced knowledge of payer reimbursement methodologies, billing regulations, and charging guidelines.


Maintains an advanced knowledge of denials in order to assist and train caregivers.


Onboards and trains caregivers.

Develops training materials and workflows specific to role.

Conducts work audits of assigned teams.

Tracks applicable statistics on a weekly and monthly basis.

Analyzes and summarizes monthly denial and adjustment data.

Leads meetings with SBO teams and other St. Charles departments.

Works with other departments and payers to resolve denials, identify adjustment trends, and make appropriate modifications to Epic build.

Point of contact for questions from SBO caregivers and other internal SCHS departments.

Participates and completes departmental and organizational projects to meet SCHS financial objectives.

Maintains advanced knowledge of department and organizational structure, workflow, and operating procedures.

Enters clear and concise documentation in the EHR.

Attends required training, completes on-line training as assigned.

Supports the vision, mission, and values of the organization in all respects.

Supports Lean principles of continuous improvement with energy and enthusiasm, functioning as a champion of change.

Provides and maintains a safe environment for caregivers, patients, and guests.

Conducts all activities with the highest standards of professionalism and confidentiality. Complies with all applicable laws, regulations, policies, and procedures, supporting the organization’s corporate integrity efforts by acting in an ethical and appropriate manner, reporting known or suspected violation of applicable rules, and cooperating fully with all organizational investigations and proceedings.

Delivers customer service and/or patient care in a manner that promotes goodwill, is timely, efficient, and accurate.

May perform additional duties of similar complexity within the organization, as required or assigned.

EDUCATION

Required: High school diploma or GED required.

Preferred: Associate degree in healthcare, accounting, finance, or other related field preferred.

LICENSURE/CERTIFICATION/REGISTRATION

Required:

Current Epic accreditation or certification in one of the following areas or ability to obtain within 365 days (12 months):

Epic Rev Cycle Builder Badge,

Resolute Professional Billing Administration,

Resolute Professional Billing Claims and Electronic Remittance Administration,

Resolute Hospital Billing Administration,

Resolute Hospital Billing Claims and Electronic Remittance Administration.

Preferred:

RHIT, Medical Coding or other applicable healthcare certification.

EXPERIENCE

Required: Five years of experience in healthcare, of which two must be in an insurance follow-up or equivalent role. Experience is finance or IT may substitute for up to two years of healthcare experience. One year of training experience.

Preferred: Applicable healthcare billing/coding and process improvement experience.

PERSONAL PROTECTIVE EQUIPMENT

Must be able to wear appropriate Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) required to perform the job safely.

ADDITIONAL POSITION INFORMATION:

Intermediate to advanced skills in Microsoft Office applications including Excel, One Note, Outlook, and Word.

Beginning to intermediate programming skills.

Strong communication skills, both verbal and written; demonstrated ability to clearly communicate complex technical problems to stakeholders with limited knowledge of operational or technological workflows.

Problem solving and research skills.

Presentation skills.

Advanced Excel skills.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS:

Continually (75% or more): Use of clear and audible speaking voice and the ability to hear normal speech level.

Frequently (50%): Sitting, standing, walking, lifting 1-10 pounds, keyboard operation, operation of motor vehicle.

Occasionally (25%): Bending, climbing stairs, reaching overhead, carrying/pushing or pulling 1-10 pounds, grasping/squeezing.

Rarely (10%): Stooping/kneeling/crouching, lifting, carrying, pushing or pulling 11-25 pounds, operation of a motor vehicle.

Never (0%): Climbing ladder/step-stool, lifting/carrying/pushing or pulling 25-50 pounds, ability to hear whispered speech level.

Exposure to Elemental Factors

Never (0%): Heat, cold, wet/slippery area, noise, dust, vibration, chemical solution, uneven surface.

Blood-Borne Pathogen (BBP) Exposure Category

No Risk for Exposure to BBP
